qpFXHip9GYcYzAcJzWqw6Q.en: Kenya reported its first imported case on 6 October, a Kenyan national residing in the Democratic Republic of the Congo who was placed in isolation upon arriving in Kenya by air on 3 October and died on 5 October. Authorities have identified 28 contacts, including 23 passengers on the same flight and 4 crew members. WHO is working closely with the country to strengthen control measures and prevent transmission. The DRC continues to report new cases: on 4 October, 59 new confirmed cases were recorded, including 34 deaths, in North Kivu (33), Ituri (23), Haut-Uélé (2) and Tshopo (1). hwxNPIlYE0lMcqSs78p8eQ.zh: WHO於9/29報告全球去(2025)年累計47個國家報告45萬1,499例病例,其中7,870例死亡,總病例數較2024年下降,惟死亡人數較2024年增加30%,為1999年以來最高之單年死亡數,疫情集中於安哥拉、孟加拉、剛果⺠主共和國、奈及利亞、南蘇丹、蘇丹及葉門等7國(占全球病例數與死亡數約90%),且非洲病例數與死亡數皆上升。WHO於今年重啟預防接種計畫,並表示口服疫苗年產量已提升至8,000萬劑,惟逾1/5死亡病例發生於醫療機構之外,突顯延誤就醫問題嚴重性,呼籲各國應加速投資安全水質與衛生等設施。
hwxNPIlYE0lMcqSs78p8eQ.en: On 29 September, WHO reported that in 2025, 47 countries cumulatively reported 451,499 cases, including 7,870 deaths. Total cases were lower than in 2024, but deaths rose 30% over 2024, the highest annual death toll since 1999. Cases were concentrated in seven countries (Angola, Bangladesh, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Nigeria, South Sudan, Sudan and Yemen), which together accounted for about 90% of global cases and deaths; cases and deaths both rose in Africa. WHO restarted vaccination programmes this year and stated that annual oral vaccine production has risen to 80 million doses. However, more than one in five deaths occurred outside health facilities, highlighting the serious problem of delayed care-seeking, and WHO called on countries to accelerate investment in safe water and sanitation.

0MvKFXu1kyWbQ2xf8thXcw.zh: 剛果⺠主共和國(DRC)今年截至8月累計報告逾39,400例疑病例,其中1,173例死亡,疫情集中於東部的北基伍省(North Kivu)與南基伍省(South Kivu),合計新增病例數占全國一半以上,局勢不穩、人口流動頻繁及缺乏安全飲水設施等係疫情上升主因,因當地同時面臨伊波拉病毒感染疫情,致醫療與人道救援體系面臨雙重壓力 。
0MvKFXu1kyWbQ2xf8thXcw.en: The DRC has reported more than 39,400 suspected cases this year through August, including 1,173 deaths. The outbreak is concentrated in the eastern provinces of North Kivu and South Kivu, which together account for more than half of new cases nationwide. Political instability, frequent population movement and a lack of safe drinking-water facilities are the main drivers of the rise. Because the area is simultaneously facing an Ebola virus disease outbreak, the health and humanitarian response systems face dual pressure.

Aa78Szc_xOu9_A7y8rWKIw.en: The DRC continues to report new cases: on 12 September, 87 new confirmed cases were added, including 38 deaths, occurring in Ituri Province (44), North Kivu Province (37), Haut-Uele Province (3) and Tshopo Province (3). As of 12 September, a cumulative 7,200 confirmed cases have been reported (3,475 deaths, 1,712 recovered), a case fatality rate of 48.3%. The outbreak is distributed across 7 provinces (62 health zones), with Ituri Province the most severe, accounting for 78% of national cases; 50.6% of the new confirmed cases added that day were also in this province. Over the past three weeks (24 August–13 September), new cases in Ituri Province fell by 25%, while cases in North Kivu Province rose by 76.1%. Women currently make up the majority of cases, and as many as 68% of deaths occurred in the community. WHO assesses that 5,000 health workers are still needed to deploy in support, and the outbreak remains a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC).

9u_kD0dhcYkoEoBa0xIZWw.zh: 剛果⺠主共和國(DRC)持續新增病例,9/10新增80例確定病例,其中49例死亡,發生於伊圖里省(30例)、北基伍省(43例)及上韋萊省(6例)、南烏班吉省(1例),另南烏班吉省新增1個受影響衛生區(Bulu),有地理區持續擴大情形。迄9/10累計7,022例確定病例(3,398例死亡、1,671例康復),致死率48.4%。 DRC疫情持續擴大,目前已影響全國7省(/26省)共62個衛生區,其中51個衛生區於過去21天內仍有病例,增幅部分可能來自監測、檢驗與診斷能力提升及未通報資料校正,惟病例與死亡持續增加亦反映社區傳播延續及明顯地理擴張。WHO於8/14評估DRC境內疫情風險為「極高(Very High)」,與DRC接壤之所有鄰國風險為「高(high)」,非洲其他地區及全球則維持「低(Low),並不建議對受影響國家實施旅行或貿易限制。 WHO表示Ervebo疫苗對BVD之人體效益仍未知,僅建議於研究計畫使用;截至9/6止,已有2,007名醫護及第一線人員接種該疫苗。
9u_kD0dhcYkoEoBa0xIZWw.en: The DRC continues to report new cases: on 10 September, 80 new confirmed cases were added, including 49 deaths, occurring in Ituri Province (30), North Kivu Province (43), Haut-Uele Province (6) and South Ubangi Province (1). South Ubangi Province has added one newly affected health zone (Bulu), and geographic spread continues. As of 10 September, a cumulative 7,022 confirmed cases have been reported (3,398 deaths, 1,671 recovered), a case fatality rate of 48.4%. The DRC outbreak continues to expand: it now affects 7 of the country's 26 provinces, across 62 health zones, 51 of which have reported cases in the past 21 days. Part of the increase may reflect improved surveillance, testing and diagnostic capacity and corrections to unreported data; however, the continued rise in cases and deaths also reflects ongoing community transmission and clear geographic expansion. WHO assessed the risk within the DRC as very high on 14 August; the risk for all countries bordering the DRC is high, and the risk for the rest of Africa and the world remains low. WHO does not recommend travel or trade restrictions on affected countries. WHO says the human benefit of the Ervebo vaccine against BVD remains unknown and recommends its use only within research protocols; as of 6 September, 2,007 health workers and frontline personnel had been vaccinated with this vaccine.

_O23ZrgT4z3_SBc_TIlw-Q.zh: 全球自2022年截至今年7/31累計145國/地區報告19萬683例確定病例,其中529例死亡。 今年7月共計32國家/地區報告1,370例確定病例,其中7例死亡(CFR:0.5%),以馬達加斯加(703例)、安哥拉(138例)、中國(88 例)、剛果⺠主共和國(55例)及肯亞(55例)為多,74.8%病例來自非洲地區。相較今年6月,全球病例數下降12.5%,僅非洲區呈上升趨勢,其餘地區下降;東南亞區及東地中海區則無通報病例。 全球已有68個國家/地區曾通報檢出Clade Ib確定病例,近6週(7/6-8/16)共有22國報告病例,其中15國出現本土社區傳播疫情,分布於非洲6國(馬達加斯加、安哥拉、肯亞、剛果⺠主共和國、南蘇丹、蒲隆地)及歐洲9國(葡萄牙、德國、法國、英國、愛爾蘭、荷蘭、義大利、瑞士及捷克)。 另馬達加斯加自2025年12月起迄今爆發全球最大規模Ib型疫情。
_O23ZrgT4z3_SBc_TIlw-Q.en: Globally, since 2022 and as of 31 July this year, 145 countries and territories have cumulatively reported 190,683 confirmed cases, including 529 deaths. In July this year, 32 countries and territories reported 1,370 confirmed cases, including 7 deaths (CFR 0.5%); the largest numbers were in Madagascar (703), Angola (138), China (88), the DRC (55) and Kenya (55), and 74.8% of cases came from Africa. Compared with June this year, global cases fell by 12.5%; only Africa showed an increase, while other regions declined, and no cases were reported from South-East Asia or the Eastern Mediterranean region. A total of 68 countries and territories have ever reported confirmed clade Ib cases. In the past six weeks (6 July–16 August), 22 countries reported cases, of which 15 have local community transmission: six in Africa (Madagascar, Angola, Kenya, the DRC, South Sudan and Burundi) and nine in Europe (Portugal, Germany, France, the United Kingdom, Ireland, the Netherlands, Italy, Switzerland and Czechia). Madagascar has been experiencing the largest clade Ib outbreak in the world since December 2025.

nhf7qHHvUe4-LhxOp5vd1Q.en: The DRC continues to report new cases: on 1 September, 64 new confirmed cases were added, including 25 deaths, occurring in Ituri Province (39), North Kivu Province (20), Haut-Uele Province (4) and Tshopo Province (1). As of 1 September, a cumulative 6,250 confirmed cases have been reported (3,039 deaths, 1,439 recovered), a case fatality rate of 48.6%. The outbreak is distributed across 6 provinces (60 health zones). The Ervebo vaccine is currently approved mainly for Zaire ebolavirus, and its protective efficacy against Bundibugyo ebolavirus has not been established. WHO does not currently support Ervebo as a routine vaccine for BDBV, and recommends its use only within research protocols or clinical study frameworks; it should not replace existing outbreak control measures such as contact tracing, infection control and safe burials.

eyQWuPfYDqHcvJN98vWFhw.zh: WHO正式宣布烏干達伊波拉疫情(Bundibugyo virus )結束。該國最後1例境外移入病例於7/16出院後,持續監測至8/27,已連續42天無新增病例。此波疫情累計20例確定病例,其中15例為自剛果⺠主共和國(DRC)境外移入,另5例為與境外移入病例相關之接觸者及醫療人員本土感染;共18例康復、2例死亡,並追蹤逾800名接觸者。本署已於8/28將該國旅遊疫情建議等級調降為「無等級」。
eyQWuPfYDqHcvJN98vWFhw.en: WHO has officially declared the end of the Bundibugyo virus outbreak in Uganda. The country's last imported case was discharged on 16 July, and monitoring continued until 27 August, with 42 consecutive days without new cases. This outbreak recorded 20 confirmed cases cumulatively: 15 imported from the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and 5 local infections among contacts of imported cases and health workers; 18 recovered, 2 died, and more than 800 contacts were followed. Taiwan CDC lowered the travel advisory level for Uganda to 'no level' on 28 August.

j2Ara_A-etjEi8K3d9nqog.zh: 全球自2022年迄2026年6月底,共145個國家/地區累計報告188,847例確定病例及521例死亡,致死率約0.3%。目前疫情風險主要集中於非洲,馬達加斯加自2025年12月起爆發目前全球最大規模疫情,已有61%行政區受影響,近期檢驗陽性率達74%,疫情尚未獲控制;剛果⺠主共和國則持續有Clade Ia及Ib共同流行,惟監測及檢驗量能下降,可能低估實際疫情規模;巴基斯坦年初發生Clade Ib院內群聚,34例確定病例中有8例嬰幼兒死亡。另全球於英國、印度及卡達發現3例Clade Ib/IIb重組病毒株,目前尚無證據顯示其傳播力或疾病嚴重度增加,仍須持續監測。WHO評估維持全球風險為中,主要以高風險性行為族群傳播為主,該族群風險為中,一般大眾則為低。
j2Ara_A-etjEi8K3d9nqog.en: Globally, from 2022 to the end of June 2026, 145 countries and territories have cumulatively reported 188,847 confirmed cases and 521 deaths, a case fatality rate of about 0.3%. Current risk is concentrated mainly in Africa. Madagascar has been experiencing the world's largest current outbreak since December 2025; 61% of its administrative areas have been affected, the recent test positivity rate has reached 74%, and the outbreak is not yet under control. The DRC continues to see co-circulation of clade Ia and Ib, but declining surveillance and testing capacity may underestimate the actual scale of the outbreak. Pakistan had a clade Ib hospital cluster early this year, in which 8 of 34 confirmed cases were infants and young children who died. In addition, 3 recombinant clade Ib/IIb virus strains have been found in the United Kingdom, India and Qatar; there is currently no evidence that transmissibility or disease severity has increased, but monitoring must continue. WHO assesses the global risk as moderate. Transmission is mainly within high-risk sexual networks, where the risk is moderate; for the general public, the risk is low.

PCK9GfgvMG8XqJXAWCWwdg.zh: 剛果⺠主共和國(DRC)持續新增病例,8/25新增57例確定病例,其中11例死亡,發生於伊圖里省(34例)、北基伍省(18例)、上韋萊省(5例)。迄8/25累計5,713例確定病例(2,744例死亡、1,269例康復),致死率48.0%,疫情分佈於6個省份(58個衛生區)。 DRC伊圖里省逾80%新感染個案未在接觸者名單內,約60%調查後仍無流行病學關聯,近三分之二死亡病例發生於治療中之外,增加社區環境暴露與葬禮感染之風險。另確定病例中女性占53%,以18‒49歲最多,推估可能與承擔醫療照護及準備葬禮等暴露有關。WHO與非洲CDC已緊急宣布分配7萬劑Ervebo 疫苗(原用於薩伊株伊波拉),其中5萬劑將提供第一線醫療人員使用,另2萬劑則投入第三期臨床試驗,以評估其對邦迪布焦病毒的防護效果。
PCK9GfgvMG8XqJXAWCWwdg.en: The DRC continues to report new cases: on 25 August, 57 new confirmed cases were added, including 11 deaths, occurring in Ituri Province (34), North Kivu Province (18) and Haut-Uele Province (5). As of 25 August, a cumulative 5,713 confirmed cases have been reported (2,744 deaths, 1,269 recovered), a case fatality rate of 48.0%; the outbreak is distributed across 6 provinces (58 health zones). More than 80% of new infections in Ituri Province were not on contact lists, and about 60% remain without an epidemiological link after investigation. Nearly two-thirds of deaths occurred outside of treatment, increasing the risk of community and funeral-related infection. Women account for 53% of confirmed cases, most of them aged 18–49, which may be linked to exposure through caring for patients and preparing funerals. WHO and Africa CDC have announced the urgent allocation of 70,000 doses of Ervebo vaccine (originally used for the Zaire strain of Ebola): 50,000 doses will go to frontline health workers, and 20,000 doses will be used in a Phase III clinical trial to assess protection against Bundibugyo virus.

U6KDJdnwBzrqnJZbLUeMvg.zh: WHO於今年5/14召開第45次IHR小兒麻痺症緊急委員會並於8/25公布決議,今年截至4/30全球累積報告16例WPV1病例、2 例cVDPV1病例、28例cVDPV2病例及2例cVDPV3病例。環境樣本部分:累計報告74件WPV1、27件cVDPV2。考量全球疫情傳播及疫苗覆蓋率,評估持續構成國際關注公共衛生緊急事件(PHEIC),並再延⻑臨時性措施3個月,惟不構成緊急大流行(Pandemic Emergency),並建議有11個國家(有WPV1、cVDPV1、cVDPV3傳播風險者)需加強疫情監測及疫苗接種等措施,包括有WPV1疫情之阿富汗、巴基斯坦、德國,有cVDPV1 疫情之阿爾及利亞、剛果⺠主共和國、吉布地、以色列、寮國,有cVDPV3疫情之喀麥隆、查德、奈及利亞;另建議24個有cVDPV2國內傳播風險的國家加強防治措施。由於核疫區的持續傳播、偏鄉與衝突地區疫苗接種覆蓋率不均以及頻繁的跨國人口流動,WPV1及cVDPV仍具有高度國際傳播風險 。 WHO於8/19宣布非洲5國cVDPV2疫情已終止,分別為蒲隆地 、迦納、幾內亞比索、剛果共和國及烏干達。當局近年透過資金與技術支援、加強疫苗接種,強化急性無力肢體麻痺監測與實驗室檢驗能力,以及應用地理資訊系統的成功阻斷疫情。
U6KDJdnwBzrqnJZbLUeMvg.en: WHO convened the 45th IHR Emergency Committee on polio on 14 May this year and published its decision on 25 August. As of 30 April this year, 16 WPV1 cases, 2 cVDPV1 cases, 28 cVDPV2 cases and 2 cVDPV3 cases had been reported worldwide. For environmental samples, 74 WPV1 and 27 cVDPV2 detections had been reported cumulatively. Considering global transmission and vaccination coverage, the committee assessed that polio continues to constitute a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC), extended temporary recommendations by 3 months, but does not constitute a Pandemic Emergency. It recommended that 11 countries at risk of WPV1, cVDPV1 or cVDPV3 transmission strengthen surveillance and vaccination: Afghanistan, Pakistan and Germany (WPV1 outbreaks); Algeria, the DRC, Djibouti, Israel and Laos (cVDPV1 outbreaks); and Cameroon, Chad and Nigeria (cVDPV3 outbreaks). It also recommended that 24 countries at risk of domestic cVDPV2 transmission strengthen control measures. Owing to continued transmission in endemic areas, uneven vaccination coverage in remote and conflict-affected areas, and frequent cross-border population movement, WPV1 and cVDPV remain at high risk of international spread. WHO declared on 19 August that cVDPV2 outbreaks had ended in five African countries: Burundi, Ghana, Guinea-Bissau, the Republic of the Congo and Uganda. In recent years, these outbreaks were stopped through financial and technical support, enhanced vaccination, strengthened acute flaccid paralysis surveillance and laboratory capacity, and the use of geographic information systems.

SyvPfLkkorvJJ1Ort3OOwg.zh: 剛果⺠主共和國(DRC)今年截至第31週累計報告11萬4,004例疑病例(78%為5歲以下兒童),1,487例死亡,已超越去年全年疫情(83,486例,死亡1,187例),其中北基伍省和南基伍省(佔47.7%)為最嚴重地區。由於武裝衝突、人口流離及多種疾病(伊波拉、霍亂與瘧疾)同時傳播等影響,導致醫療體系嚴重負擔,無國界醫師(MSF)已在北基伍/南基伍省實施介入措施,避免疫情傳播。Beacon 8/18 瑞典疫情持續,今年截至8/24累計30例確定病例,均為參與今年音樂節(7/30-8/2)相關病例,多數為18歲以下未接種過疫苗之兒童,其中以斯德哥爾摩(9例)及西博滕省(6例)為多。由於該節日吸引約萬名遊客參加,該國與各地感染管制相關部門進行接觸者追蹤,並建議未接種疫苗或接種不完整者進行自主監測。 莫三比克自2025/7/29宣布爆發疫情後,截至今年8/18累計報告2,595例確定病例,4例死亡。主要以北部南普拉省(1,137例病例,4例死亡)較為嚴重,其次為索法拉省(585例)。相較今年3月資料(697例,1例死亡),短期間內增加1,898例。
SyvPfLkkorvJJ1Ort3OOwg.en: The DRC has reported 114,004 suspected cases this year as of week 31 (78% of them children under 5), with 1,487 deaths, already exceeding last year's total (83,486 cases and 1,187 deaths). The worst-affected areas are North Kivu and South Kivu provinces (47.7%). Armed conflict, population displacement and the simultaneous spread of multiple diseases (Ebola, cholera and malaria) are placing a severe burden on the health system. Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) has implemented interventions in North Kivu and South Kivu to prevent transmission (Beacon, 18 August). Sweden's outbreak continues: as of 24 August this year, 30 confirmed cases have been cumulatively reported, all linked to this year's music festival (30 July–2 August). Most were unvaccinated children under 18, with cases concentrated in Stockholm (9) and Västerbotten (6). As the festival drew about 10,000 visitors, the country and regional infection-control authorities are conducting contact tracing and recommend self-monitoring for those who are unvaccinated or incompletely vaccinated. Mozambique has reported 2,595 confirmed cases cumulatively as of 18 August this year, including 4 deaths, since declaring an outbreak on 29 July 2025. The worst-affected area is Nampula Province in the north (1,137 cases, 4 deaths), followed by Sofala Province (585 cases). Compared with 697 cases and 1 death in March this year, cases have increased by 1,898 in a short period.

sbEEbS1A7qe20LzrFtd8mQ.zh: WHO於8/14最新風險評估剛果⺠主共和國(DRC)維持極高傳播風險;與DRC接壤之所有鄰國 (包含烏干達) 仍面臨境外移入傳播風險,列為高風險;非洲其他地區及全球維持低風險,並呼籲各國須維持高度監測,且落實各項防治措施。其中烏干達風險等級由「極高風險」調降到「高風險」。 剛果⺠主共和國(DRC)持續新增病例,8/20新增85例確定病例,其中18例死亡,發生於伊圖里省(63例)、北基伍省(17例)、上韋萊省(5例) ,目前累計5,375例確定病例(2,557例死亡、1,167例康復),致死率47.6%,疫情分佈於6個省份(56個衛生區)。
sbEEbS1A7qe20LzrFtd8mQ.en: In its latest risk assessment on 14 August, WHO maintains the risk of transmission in the DRC as very high. All neighbouring countries bordering the DRC (including Uganda) still face the risk of imported transmission and are rated high risk; the rest of Africa and the world remain at low risk. WHO calls on countries to maintain high levels of surveillance and implement control measures. Uganda's risk level has been lowered from very high to high. The DRC continues to report new cases: on 20 August, 85 new confirmed cases were added, including 18 deaths, occurring in Ituri Province (63), North Kivu Province (17) and Haut-Uele Province (5). The cumulative total is now 5,375 confirmed cases (2,557 deaths, 1,167 recovered), a case fatality rate of 47.6%; the outbreak is distributed across 6 provinces (56 health zones).

Ci0xRhuKWrHmsgxORGlJfw.zh: 剛果⺠主共和國(DRC)疫情傳播加劇,第32週(8/3-9)新增 579例確定病例及304例死亡,創下單週最高紀錄。近期新增1個受影響省份,巴斯韋萊省(Bas-Uélé)報告1例具上韋萊省旅遊史之確定病例(8/4發病)。目前地理區持續擴大,疫情已蔓延全國6個省份(伊圖里省、北基伍省、南基伍省、上韋萊省、喬波省與巴斯韋萊省)54個衛生區,其中伊圖里省最為嚴峻,佔全國85%病例數及79%死亡數。截至8/12累計4,665例確定病例(2,184例死亡、965例康復),致死率46.8%。本次疫情規模及擴散速度已超越以往紀錄(2018年至2020年累計3,317例)。 自疫情爆發以來,醫護人員感染情形持續發生。截至8/9至少155例確定病例(其中45例死亡及68例康復),凸顯職業暴露風險與院感控制(IPC)挑戰。在安全局勢動盪、人口大規模流離失所等背景下,防疫小組的行動屢遭阻礙。自5/17宣布國際關注公共衛生緊急事件(PHEIC)以來,已紀錄到12起針對醫療設施之襲擊事件。
Ci0xRhuKWrHmsgxORGlJfw.en: The outbreak in the DRC is intensifying: in week 32 (3–9 August), 579 new confirmed cases and 304 deaths were added, the highest weekly record. A new province has recently been affected: Bas-Uélé Province reported one confirmed case with a history of travel to Haut-Uele Province (onset 4 August). Geographic spread continues; the outbreak has now reached 6 provinces across the country (Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, Tshopo and Bas-Uélé), covering 54 health zones. Ituri Province is the most severe, accounting for 85% of national cases and 79% of deaths. As of 12 August, a cumulative 4,665 confirmed cases (2,184 deaths, 965 recovered) have been reported, a case fatality rate of 46.8%. The scale and speed of spread of this outbreak have exceeded previous records (3,317 cumulative cases in 2018–2020). Healthcare worker infections have continued since the outbreak began: as of 9 August, at least 155 confirmed cases among health workers had been recorded (45 died and 68 recovered), highlighting occupational exposure risks and infection prevention and control (IPC) challenges. Against a backdrop of unstable security and large-scale population displacement, response teams have repeatedly been obstructed. Since the PHEIC was declared on 17 May, 12 attacks on health facilities have been recorded.

Sg5rO5aBp53OlOF0uIAOBg.zh: 剛果⺠主共和國(DRC)持續新增病例,截至8/10累計4,449例確定病例(2,061例死亡、886例康復),致死率46.3%,疫情分佈於5個省份(53個衛生區),主要集中於伊圖里省,另南基伍省已連續75天無新增病例。 非洲CDC表示,此次疫情傳播速度為2014年至2016年西非大流行同期的7倍 。目前接觸者追蹤率僅75%,遠低於95%目標,且高達70%的新增病例未列於接觸者名單。另逾3分之2的死亡個案發生於社區而非治療中,顯示患者可能普遍存在延遲就醫,或未能及時獲得醫療照護之情形。
Sg5rO5aBp53OlOF0uIAOBg.en: The DRC continues to report new cases: as of 10 August, a cumulative 4,449 confirmed cases have been reported (2,061 deaths, 886 recovered), a case fatality rate of 46.3%. The outbreak is distributed across 5 provinces (53 health zones), mainly concentrated in Ituri Province; South Kivu Province has gone 75 consecutive days without new cases. The Africa CDC said the speed of this outbreak is seven times that of the same period during the 2014–2016 West African epidemic. The current contact tracing rate is only 75%, far below the 95% target, and as many as 70% of new cases are not on contact lists. In addition, more than two-thirds of deaths occurred in the community rather than during treatment, indicating that patients commonly delay seeking care or fail to receive timely medical care.

6iEZEKN2ZqktfWwQ4A6xjA.zh: 剛果⺠主共和國(DRC)持續新增病例,8/7新增89例確定病例,其中21例死亡,發生於伊圖里省(73例)、北基伍省(12例)、上韋萊省(4例)。新增4個受影響的衛生區,有地理區持續擴大情形。迄至8/7累計4,209例確定病例(1,916例死亡、828例康復),致死率45.5%,疫情分佈於5個省份(53個衛生區),以伊圖里省最為嚴峻,佔全國86.3%的病例數。
6iEZEKN2ZqktfWwQ4A6xjA.en: The Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) continues to report new cases. On 7 August, 89 new confirmed cases were added, including 21 deaths, in Ituri Province (73 cases), North Kivu Province (12) and Haut-Uélé Province (4). Four newly affected health zones were added, and the geographic spread continues to expand. As of 7 August, cumulative confirmed cases stand at 4,209 (1,916 deaths, 828 recoveries), a case fatality ratio of 45.5%. Cases are distributed across 5 provinces (53 health zones), with Ituri Province the most severely affected, accounting for 86.3% of national cases.

x_x_T5Py_a895mFpCWgcRA.zh: 剛果⺠主共和國(DRC)疫情持續,截至8/7累計報告4,053例確定病例,其中1,850例死亡(CFR:45.6%),疫情分佈於5個省份。因應此波疫情快速發展,WHO於8/7建議將現行已核准針對薩伊株(Zaire)的伊波拉疫苗(Ervebo)納入臨床試驗,研發單位將於邦迪布焦(Bundibugyo)疫苗的第二/三期臨床試驗時一併將Ervebo納入疫苗效力評估。
x_x_T5Py_a895mFpCWgcRA.en: The outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) continues. As of 7 August, 4,053 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively, including 1,850 deaths (CFR: 45.6%), distributed across 5 provinces. In response to the rapid development of this wave of the outbreak, WHO on 7 August recommended including Ervebo, the currently licensed Ebola vaccine targeting the Zaire strain, in clinical trials. Developers will also include Ervebo in vaccine efficacy evaluation alongside the Phase II/III clinical trials of the Bundibugyo vaccine.

8eMNaDR1HZHBQWERWxqhQg.zh: 剛果⺠主共和國(DRC)持續新增病例,8/3新增72例確定病例,其中44例死亡,發生於伊圖里省(58例)、北基伍省(12例)、上韋萊省(2例)。目前累計3,874例確定病例(1,751例死亡、749例康復),致死率45.1%,疫情分佈於5個省份(51個衛生區)。 莫德納公司已於加拿大啟動mRNA-1469候選疫苗第一期人體臨床試驗,以評估其預防邦迪布焦伊波拉病毒(BDBV)之安全性及抗體反應,目前首批受試者已完成接種。
8eMNaDR1HZHBQWERWxqhQg.en: The Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) continues to report new cases. On 3 August, 72 new confirmed cases were added, including 44 deaths, in Ituri Province (58 cases), North Kivu Province (12) and Haut-Uélé Province (2). Cumulatively, 3,874 confirmed cases have been reported (1,751 deaths, 749 recoveries), a case fatality ratio of 45.1%. The outbreak is distributed across 5 provinces (51 health zones). Moderna has begun a Phase 1 human clinical trial of its mRNA-1469 candidate vaccine in Canada to assess its safety and antibody response in preventing Bundibugyo ebolavirus (BDBV) infection, and the first group of participants has completed vaccination.

9uOBV4r2QxonYBAtXyf2cQ.zh: 剛果⺠主共和國(DRC)持續新增病例,8/2新增58例確定病例,其中40例死亡,發生於伊圖里省(39例)、北基伍省(18例)、上韋萊省(1例)。新增2個受影響的衛生區(位於喬波省Wanie-Rukula、北基伍省Lubero),有地理區持續擴大情形。目前累計3,802例確定病例(1,707例死亡、727例康復),致死率44.9%,疫情分佈於5個省份(51個衛生區),以伊圖里省最為嚴峻,佔全國87%病例數;北基伍省為第二大疫情熱區,惟其致死率高於伊圖里省約27%,顯示該省病例可能存在延遲發現情形。
9uOBV4r2QxonYBAtXyf2cQ.en: The Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) continues to report new cases. On 2 August, 58 new confirmed cases were added, including 40 deaths, in Ituri Province (39 cases), North Kivu Province (18) and Haut-Uélé Province (1). Two newly affected health zones were added, in Wanie-Rukula (Tshopo Province) and Lubero (North Kivu Province), and the geographic spread continues to expand. To date, 3,802 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively (1,707 deaths, 727 recoveries), a case fatality ratio of 44.9%. The outbreak is distributed across 5 provinces (51 health zones), with Ituri Province the most severely affected at 87% of national cases. North Kivu is the second-largest hotspot, but its case fatality ratio is about 27% higher than that of Ituri, which suggests that cases in that province may be detected with a delay.

nVUsMQAYFu4ybG_wrTQxoA.zh: 全球自2022年截至今年6/30累計145國/地區報告18萬8,565例確定病例,其中521例死亡。 今年6月共計33國家/地區報告1,128例確定病例,其中9例死亡(CFR:0.8%),以馬達加斯加(546例)、美國(111例)、剛果⺠主共和國(86例)、英國(46例)及葡萄牙(45例)為高,64%病例來自非洲地區。相較今年5月,美洲區及東南亞區病例數呈上升趨勢,其餘地區疫情則下降;東地中海區則無通報病例。哥斯大黎加、迦納及立陶宛通報首例Ib型病例;幾內亞比索首度通報3例IIb型病例。 非洲地區近6週(6/8-7/19)共計10國報告1,112例確定病例,其中12例死亡(CFR:1.1%),以馬達加斯加(940例)、安哥拉(57例)、肯亞(48例)、剛果⺠主共和國(30例)及喀麥隆(24例)為高。 非洲以外地區,共11國報告Ib型社區傳播;近6週報告Ib型病例最多國家為葡萄牙(60例),其次為英國(31例)、泰國(29例)、法國(18例)及西班牙(16例)。 馬達加斯加自2025年12月起爆發全球最大規模Ib型疫情,截至7/19,累計報告2,921例確定病例及18例死亡(CFR:0.6%)。疫情擴及全國61%行政區(70/115),主要影響15-49歲族群。雖已推動MVA-BN疫苗接種(89,723人施打第1劑),惟因檢測陽性率由65%上升至74%,以及面臨疫苗缺貨、冷鏈物流、醫療量能與風險溝通等挑戰,疫情迄未受到控制。 安哥拉自今年5月中旬起疫情升溫,截至7/19累計108例確定病例及1例死亡(CFR 0.9%),主要集中於Cabinda省(佔80%),52%病例為20-29歲族群,其中女性及女童比例高達66%,當局已啟動相關防治措施。
nVUsMQAYFu4ybG_wrTQxoA.en: Globally, from 2022 through 30 June this year, 145 countries and territories have reported 188,565 confirmed mpox cases, including 521 deaths. In June this year, 33 countries and territories reported 1,128 confirmed cases, including 9 deaths (CFR: 0.8%). The highest numbers were in Madagascar (546), the United States (111), the Democratic Republic of the Congo (86), the United Kingdom (46) and Portugal (45), and 64% of cases came from the African Region. Compared with May this year, case numbers rose in the Region of the Americas and the South-East Asia Region and declined in other regions; the Eastern Mediterranean Region reported no cases. Costa Rica, Ghana and Lithuania reported their first clade Ib cases, and Guinea-Bissau reported 3 clade IIb cases for the first time. In the African Region, over the past 6 weeks (8 June–19 July), 10 countries reported 1,112 confirmed cases, including 12 deaths (CFR: 1.1%). The highest numbers were in Madagascar (940), Angola (57), Kenya (48), the Democratic Republic of the Congo (30) and Cameroon (24). Outside Africa, 11 countries have reported clade Ib community transmission. Over the past 6 weeks, the countries reporting the most clade Ib cases were Portugal (60), the United Kingdom (31), Thailand (29), France (18) and Spain (16). Madagascar has experienced the world's largest clade Ib outbreak since December 2025. As of 19 July, 2,921 confirmed cases and 18 deaths (CFR: 0.6%) have been reported cumulatively. The outbreak has spread to 61% of the country's administrative areas (70 of 115), mainly affecting people aged 15–49 years. Although MVA-BN vaccination has begun (89,723 people have received the first dose), the test positivity rate has risen from 65% to 74%, and challenges including vaccine shortages, cold chain logistics, health system capacity and risk communication remain, so the outbreak is not yet under control. Angola's outbreak has intensified since mid-May this year. As of 19 July, 108 confirmed cases and 1 death (CFR: 0.9%) have been reported cumulatively, mainly concentrated in Cabinda Province (80%). Of cases, 52% are aged 20–29 years, and females and girls account for as much as 66%. Authorities have launched related prevention and control measures.

R0ekqkQXC6JwHevI28EwNQ.zh: 剛果⺠主共和國(DRC)持續新增病例,7/31新增69例確定病例,其中34例死亡,發生於伊圖里省(53例)、北基伍省(12例)、上韋萊省(4例),喬波省於7/30新增一個受影響衛生區,有地理區持續擴大情形。目前累計3,674例確定病例(含1,621例死亡、666例康復),致死率44.1%,疫情分佈於5個省份共49個衛生區,其中以伊圖里省最為嚴峻,佔全國88%病例數。 烏干達於7/28宣布該國疫情結束,因其最後1例本土確定病例於6/16康復出院後,已連續42天未新增本土病例。惟依循國際準則,最近1例境外移入患者於7/16出院,WHO自該日(7/16)進行為期42天之監測追蹤,以確保沒有任何遺漏之傳播鏈。鑑於鄰國DRC疫情持續擴大、人員流動等跨境傳播風險,該國仍可能面臨境外移入傳播之風險,須維持高度監測及相關防治措施。
R0ekqkQXC6JwHevI28EwNQ.en: The Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) continues to report new cases. On 31 July, 69 new confirmed cases were added, including 34 deaths, in Ituri Province (53 cases), North Kivu Province (12) and Haut-Uélé Province (4). On 30 July, one newly affected health zone was added in Tshopo Province, and the geographic spread continues to expand. As of 31 July, cumulative confirmed cases stand at 3,674 (including 1,621 deaths and 666 recoveries), a case fatality ratio of 44.1%. Cases are distributed across 5 provinces (49 health zones), with Ituri Province the most severely affected, accounting for 88% of national cases. Uganda declared the end of its outbreak on 28 July. Its last locally confirmed case recovered and was discharged on 16 June, and no new locally acquired cases have been reported for 42 consecutive days since then. However, in line with international standards, the most recent imported patient was discharged on 16 July, and WHO began 42 days of follow-up monitoring from that date to ensure no transmission chains were missed. Given the continued expansion of the DRC outbreak and the cross-border transmission risk from population movement, Uganda may still face imported transmission and must maintain high-level surveillance and related control measures.

yGufb5EAjtlbAQx-uqItQA.en: The Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) continues to report new cases. On 26 July, 62 new confirmed cases were added, including 32 deaths, in Ituri Province (53 cases), North Kivu Province (8) and Haut-Uélé Province (1). Cumulatively, 3,262 confirmed cases have been reported (including 1,437 deaths and 583 recoveries), a case fatality ratio of 44.1%. Cases are distributed across 5 provinces (48 health zones). Although case numbers continue to rise, the speed of geographic spread has slowed. Between 16 and 25 July, the number of affected health zones increased only slightly, from 46 to 48. Since 6 July, Ituri Province has increased from 25 to 28 affected health zones (out of 36 in total). The world's first BDBV-specific vaccine, ChAdOx1 BDBV, developed by the University of Oxford, was given to its first volunteer on 24 July.

weTKiPF0LtEvTffGzAMG9w.zh: 剛果⺠主共和國(DRC)持續新增病例,7/24新增102例確定病例,其中45例死亡,發生於伊圖里省(87例)、北基伍省(9例)及上韋萊省(6例),7/23新增1個受影響的衛生區(上韋萊省Rungu),有地理區持續擴大情形。目前累計3,075例確定病例(含1,354例死亡、556例康復),致死率44.0%,疫情分佈於5個省份共48個衛生區,其中以伊圖里省最為嚴峻,佔全國89%病例數。 重災區伊圖里省爆發嚴重公衛危機,百名醫療人員因連續兩個月未獲發薪資獎金,於7/25起發起罷工,已嚴重癱瘓布亞(Bunia)治療中運作,並導致病患死亡。此外,因高風險工作環境,迄今已逾100名醫療照護人員不幸染疫。WHO表示由於迄今仍未找到指標個案,再加上東部地區武裝衝突、非法採礦、人口流離失所及部分⺠眾不信任政府,導致疫情追蹤工作困難。 本次疫情蔓延速度超越以往,為史上第三大規模。啟動應變措施僅40天,確定病例數即突破千例;相較2018年DRC北基伍省疫情,當時耗時235天才達此規模。
weTKiPF0LtEvTffGzAMG9w.en: The Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) continues to report new cases. On 24 July, 102 new confirmed cases were added, including 45 deaths, in Ituri Province (87 cases), North Kivu Province (9) and Haut-Uélé Province (6). On 23 July, one newly affected health zone was added (Rungu in Haut-Uélé Province), and the geographic spread continues to expand. To date, 3,075 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively (including 1,354 deaths and 556 recoveries), a case fatality ratio of 44.0%. Cases are distributed across 5 provinces (48 health zones), with Ituri Province the most severely affected, accounting for 89% of national cases. Ituri, the hardest-hit province, is facing a serious public health crisis: about 100 health workers began a strike on 25 July after two consecutive months without salaries and bonuses. The strike has severely disrupted operations at the treatment centre in Bunia and has led to patient deaths. In addition, more than 100 healthcare workers have been infected because of the high-risk working environment. WHO has said that because no index case has yet been identified, and because of armed conflict in the eastern region, illegal mining, population displacement and some people's distrust of the government, contact tracing has been difficult. This outbreak is spreading faster than previous ones and is the third-largest on record. Confirmed cases exceeded 1,000 just 40 days after the response was activated; by comparison, the 2018 outbreak in North Kivu Province took 235 days to reach this scale.

y02ozEKU3FeZeldToHWnyA.en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported for the period 9–15 July: WPV1 cases increased by 4 in Afghanistan; cVDPV1 cases increased by 3 across 2 countries, with 2 in Ethiopia and 1 in South Sudan; cVDPV2 cases increased by 3 across 2 countries, with 2 in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and 1 in Chad; and cVDPV3 cases increased by 1 in Nigeria. 6Wr7CB2J61PMs4Ct4w2-Ug.zh: 美國疫情持續上升,今年截至7/16,累計報告2,260例確定病例,接近去年全年2,289例,多數為19歲以下(70%)族群,有146 例(6%)需住院治療,且有高達93%患者未接種疫苗或接種狀態不明。疫情主要集中於南卡羅來納州(670例),其次為猶他州(518例)、德州(182例)及維吉亞州(176)例;該國持續進行病例和接觸者調查、廢水監測與擴大疫苗接種等防治措施。 孟加拉今年截至7/15,累計報告逾11萬例病例(1萬3,907例確定病例),累計達771例(95例確定)死亡,以首都達卡(8,912例確定病例、59例死亡)最為嚴峻,疫情呈地域性蔓延,全國8個行政區均有通報及死亡病例。儘管該國疫苗覆蓋率高達99%,惟疫情仍持續傳播,懷疑覆蓋率高為近期加強推動接種活動的結果,後續仍需結合常規免疫指標,監測流行學病學趨勢。 剛果⺠主共和國(DRC)疫情上升,今年截至6/28,累計報告9萬9,200例確定病例,高於去年同期3萬4,000例,主要集中於東部南基伍省(26,900例)和北基伍省(17,500例),兩省總病例數合計佔該國45%;由於該國面臨兒童營養不良、武裝衝突等因素,影響WHO常規疫苗接種計畫,導致該國疫情擴大。
6Wr7CB2J61PMs4Ct4w2-Ug.en: The outbreak in the United States continues to rise. As of 16 July this year, 2,260 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively, approaching last year's full-year total of 2,289. Most (70%) are aged under 19 years; 146 (6%) required hospitalization, and as many as 93% of patients were unvaccinated or had unknown vaccination status. The outbreak is concentrated in South Carolina (670 cases), followed by Utah (518), Texas (182) and Virginia (176). The country continues case and contact investigations, wastewater surveillance and expanded vaccination. In Bangladesh, as of 15 July this year, more than 110,000 cases have been reported cumulatively (13,907 confirmed cases), and cumulative deaths have reached 771 (95 confirmed). The capital, Dhaka, is the most severely affected (8,912 confirmed cases and 59 deaths), and the outbreak is spreading regionally, with cases and deaths reported in all 8 administrative divisions nationwide. Although the country's vaccination coverage is as high as 99%, transmission continues. It is suspected that the high coverage rate is the result of recently intensified vaccination campaigns, so routine immunization indicators need to be considered alongside monitoring of epidemiological trends. In the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), cases are rising. As of 28 June this year, 99,200 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively, higher than the 34,000 in the same period last year. Cases are concentrated in South Kivu Province (26,900) and North Kivu Province (17,500), which together account for 45% of the national total. Because of factors including child malnutrition and armed conflict, which affect WHO's routine vaccination programme, the outbreak has expanded.

6w5TgFDVx8__OULg4dg8XQ.zh: 剛果⺠主共和國(DRC)持續新增病例,7/18新增83例確定病例,其中40例死亡,發生於伊圖里省(67例)及北基伍省(16例),有地理區持續擴大情形。目前疫情分佈於5個省份共46個衛生區,其中以伊圖里省最為嚴峻,佔全國89%病例數。 全球疫情概況:截至7/18,疫情波及4個國家,累計報告2,367例確定病例,其中932例死亡(CFR:39%)。病例主要集中於DRC ,計2,344例確定病例(含930例死亡、466例康復);鄰國烏干達計20例確定病例(含2例死亡、18例康復),其個案均與跨境移動及醫療照護暴露有關;美國計2例(含1例已康復)、法國計1例(已康復),此零星個案皆為於DRC當地進行醫療照護之人員或人道救援者。
6w5TgFDVx8__OULg4dg8XQ.en: The Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) continues to report new cases. On 18 July, 83 new confirmed cases were added, including 40 deaths, in Ituri Province (67 cases) and North Kivu Province (16), and the geographic spread continues to expand. The outbreak is currently distributed across 5 provinces (46 health zones), with Ituri Province the most severely affected, accounting for 89% of national cases. Uo1ncl2kInebLwH8bjDCiA.en: In Mangumo, a remote mining village in Lubero health zone, North Kivu Province, DRC, an unexplained deadly illness has recently broken out. From 25 June to 4 July, 9 deaths were reported cumulatively, and several other patients are critically ill. The main symptoms are diarrhoea, fever and headache, and no laboratory diagnostic results are yet available. Experts assess that the pathogen may be cholera, typhoid, malaria or BVD virus. Lubero has not been listed as an area affected by the current Ebola outbreak and has no epidemiological link to it.

jGKYoFtOUgZ4gLWQpheXrA.en: Globally, from 2022 through 31 May this year, 144 countries and territories have reported 185,882 confirmed cases, including 509 deaths. In May this year, 32 countries and territories reported 1,142 confirmed cases, including 3 deaths (CFR 0.3%). The highest numbers were in Madagascar (649), China (89), France (63), Australia (50) and Germany (45), and 63.9% of cases came from the African Region. Compared with April this year, case numbers rose in the Western Pacific and African Regions and declined in other regions. Norway reported its first clade Ib case, and Poland's earlier clade I case has been identified as a clade Ib sub-lineage. In the African Region, over the past 6 weeks (4 May–14 June), 10 countries reported 790 confirmed cases, including 3 deaths (CFR 0.45%). The highest numbers were in Madagascar, Kenya, Guinea, South Sudan, Cameroon and the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Outside Africa, Spain and Thailand continued to report clade Ib community transmission. Madagascar has faced the world's largest clade Ib outbreak since December 2025. As of 14 June this year, 2,117 confirmed cases and 7 deaths (mostly among immunocompromised people) have been reported cumulatively. The outbreak has spread to 60% of the country's administrative areas (69 of 115), mainly affecting people aged 15 to 49 years. Although MVA-BN vaccination has been rolled out (more than 79,000 people vaccinated), the outbreak remains uncontrolled because of challenges including vaccine shortages, cold chain logistics and health system capacity.

1hnt0k2bi3ywo6hrPDfOfg.zh: 剛果⺠主共和國(DRC)疫情更新,迄6/11累計689例確定病例(139例死亡、32例康復),致死率(CFR)20.2%,疫情主要集中在伊圖里省、北基伍與南基伍省共29個行政區,DRC接觸者追蹤率約28.4%。另過去24小時新增17例確定病例於伊圖里省,其中5例死亡。 烏干達於過去24小時無新增病例,迄至6/14累計19例確定病例(2例死亡、5例康復),確定病例中有14例為境外移入。 WHO評估DRC風險為「非常高」,烏干達以及與已記錄BDBV 檢出國家接壤的其他國家之風險為「高」,非洲其他地區以及全球之風險為「低」。
1hnt0k2bi3ywo6hrPDfOfg.en: The DRC has reported 689 confirmed cases cumulatively as of 11 June (139 deaths, 32 recoveries), a case fatality ratio of 20.2%. Cases are mainly concentrated in Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu provinces, across 29 administrative areas, and the DRC's contact tracing rate is about 28.4%. In addition, 17 new confirmed cases were added in Ituri Province in the past 24 hours, of which 5 died. Uganda reported no new cases in the past 24 hours; as of 14 June, 19 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively (2 deaths, 5 recoveries), of which 14 were imported. WHO assesses the risk in the DRC as very high, the risk for Uganda and other countries bordering countries where BDBV has been detected as high, and the risk for other African countries and globally as low.

EXVaiKpz1ZW5BRi64qXj2g.zh: 剛果⺠主共和國(DRC)疫情更新,迄6/9累計635例確定病例(127 例死亡、30例康復),致死率(CFR)20%,疫情主要集中在伊圖里省、北基伍與南基伍省共26個衛生區,DRC接觸者追蹤率約56.3%,WHO表示接觸者追蹤目標為90-95%。另過去24小時新增37例確定病例於伊圖里省,其中12例死亡。另6/9發表之研究推估DRC截至5/27累計病例數介於280-2,520之間。 烏干達於過去24小時無新增病例,迄至6/10累計19例確定病例(2 例死亡、5例康復),確定病例中有14例為境外移入。
EXVaiKpz1ZW5BRi64qXj2g.en: DRC outbreak update: as of 9 June, 635 confirmed cases have been reported (127 deaths, 30 recovered), with a CFR of 20%. The outbreak is concentrated in 26 health zones across Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu provinces. DRC's contact tracing rate is about 56.3%; WHO states the contact tracing target is 90–95%. In the past 24 hours, 37 new confirmed cases were added in Ituri Province, of which 12 died. A study published on 9 June estimates DRC's cumulative case count as of 27 May at between 280 and 2,520. Uganda reported no new cases in the past 24 hours; as of 10 June it had 19 cumulative confirmed cases (2 deaths, 5 recovered), 14 of which were imported.

FhkXIOrTCcwwvvjb024a5Q.zh: 剛果⺠主共和國(DRC)疫情更新,迄至6/8累計598例確定病例(115例死亡、22例康復),致死率19.2%,疫情主要集中在伊圖里省、北基伍與南基伍省共25個衛生區,DRC接觸者追蹤率約56.3%,WHO表示接觸者追蹤目標為90-95%。另過去24小時新增48例確診病例(伊圖里省45例、北基伍省3例),其中14例死亡。 烏干達疫情更新,迄至6/9累計19例確定病例(2例死亡、5例康復),確定病例中有14例為境外移入。
FhkXIOrTCcwwvvjb024a5Q.en: DRC outbreak update: as of 8 June, 598 confirmed cases have been reported (115 deaths, 22 recovered), with a CFR of 19.2%. The outbreak is concentrated in 25 health zones across Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu provinces. DRC's contact tracing rate is about 56.3%; WHO states the contact tracing target is 90–95%. In the past 24 hours, 48 new confirmed cases were added (45 in Ituri Province and 3 in North Kivu Province), of which 14 died. Uganda outbreak update: as of 9 June, it had 19 cumulative confirmed cases (2 deaths, 5 recovered), 14 of which were imported.

WBipd1MxFRHR2dFk9lqbtg.zh: 剛果⺠主共和國(DRC)疫情更新,迄至6/7累計550例確定病例(101例死亡、19例康復),致死率18.4%,疫情主要集中在伊圖里省、北基伍與南基伍省共25個衛生區,DRC接觸者追蹤率約64.4%。過去 24 小時新增35例確診病例(伊圖里省31例、北基伍省4例),其中10例死亡。  WHO維持評估DRC風險為「非常高」,烏干達及已確認BDBV檢出國家接壤之其他國家為「高」,非洲區域其餘國家及全球風險為「低」。
WBipd1MxFRHR2dFk9lqbtg.en: DRC outbreak update: as of 7 June, 550 confirmed cases have been reported (101 deaths, 19 recovered), with a CFR of 18.4%. The outbreak is concentrated in 25 health zones across Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu provinces. DRC's contact tracing rate is about 64.4%. In the past 24 hours, 35 new confirmed cases were added (31 in Ituri Province and 4 in North Kivu Province), of which 10 died. WHO maintains its risk assessment for DRC as very high, for Uganda and other countries bordering those where BDBV has been confirmed as high, and for the rest of the African region and globally as low.

TNdBRnh0EJcY8A4iGFNsGQ.zh: 剛果⺠主共和國(DRC)疫情更新,迄至6/6累計515例確定病例(91例死亡、12例康復),致死率17.7%,疫情主要集中在伊圖里省、北基伍與南基伍省共25個衛生區,DRC接觸者追蹤率約50.3%。過去 24 小時新增27例確診病例,均集中在伊圖里省。 1名在剛果⺠主共和國(DRC)伊圖里省布亞(Bunia)醫院執行手術而暴露感染的美國籍醫師,於德國醫院接受治療(包括實驗性治療), 現已康復出院。該病患於5/20後送德國,接受抗病毒藥物及支持性治療後,因連續72小時無症狀,且2次PCR結果為陰性,故解除隔離。其5名同住家人接觸者,經預防性隔離均無症狀 。
TNdBRnh0EJcY8A4iGFNsGQ.en: DRC outbreak update: as of 6 June, 515 confirmed cases have been reported (91 deaths, 12 recovered), with a CFR of 17.7%. The outbreak is concentrated in 25 health zones across Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu provinces. DRC's contact tracing rate is about 50.3%. In the past 24 hours, 27 new confirmed cases were added, all in Ituri Province. A US citizen physician who was exposed to infection while performing surgery at Bunia Hospital in Ituri Province, DRC, was treated in a German hospital, including with experimental therapy, and has now recovered and been discharged. The physician was transferred to Germany after 20 May and received antiviral drugs and supportive care. Isolation was lifted after 72 consecutive hours without symptoms and two negative PCR results. Five household contacts placed under precautionary isolation remained asymptomatic.

kZIfjnb25tN1rTnJTicyng.zh: 剛果⺠主共和國(DRC)疫情更新,迄至6/3累計381例確定病例(64例死亡、7例康復),疫情主要集中在伊圖里省、北基伍與南基伍省共25個衛生區,DRC接觸者追蹤率約55.5%。 美國CDC 於6/5 MMWR 表示目前R0相對較高,且隔離率低於50%情況下,預估有1萬例確診與2,000例死亡。另評估疫情輸入與社區傳播機率極低,在未來 3 個月對美國一般⺠眾整體風險為「低」,惟一旦發生個案,疾病嚴重度與防疫資源需求將造成「高影響」。
kZIfjnb25tN1rTnJTicyng.en: DRC outbreak update: as of 3 June, 381 confirmed cases have been reported (64 deaths, 7 recovered). The outbreak is concentrated in 25 health zones across Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu provinces. DRC's contact tracing rate is about 55.5%. The US CDC, in its 5 June MMWR, stated that with a relatively high R0 and an isolation rate below 50%, it estimates 10,000 confirmed cases and 2,000 deaths. The CDC assessed the probability of importation and community transmission as extremely low. Over the next three months, the overall risk to the general US public is rated low; however, if a case occurs, the high impact on disease severity and prevention resource needs would be rated high.

YDRE_uMnHEIt6rRXBhu5Pw.zh: 安哥拉自 2024 年至 2026/5/29,全國累計 13 例確定病例,主要分布於接壤剛果民主共和國(DRC)的卡賓達省(9 例)與烏伊熱省(4 例)。卡賓達近期新通報 3 例均為無旅遊史個案,顯示已發生本土社區傳播,惟病毒分支類型尚待確認。目前該國 MVA-BN 疫苗優先提供給邊境警察接種,一般社區民眾則缺乏保護力。
YDRE_uMnHEIt6rRXBhu5Pw.en: From 2024 to 29 May 2026, Angola has reported 13 confirmed cases nationwide, mainly in Cabinda Province (9) and Uíge Province (4), both bordering the DRC. The three newly reported cases in Cabinda had no travel history, indicating local community transmission, although the virus clade has yet to be confirmed. The MVA-BN vaccine is currently prioritised for border police, leaving the general community without protection.

z8yLb29WscLB_zR8c2jXyQ.zh: 剛果民主共和國(DRC)疫情更新,迄至 6/2 累計 363 例確定病例(62 例死亡、6 例康復),疫情主要集中在伊圖里省、北基伍與南基伍省共 25 個衛生區,其中重災區伊圖里省新增曼巴薩(Mambasa)衛生區,DRC 接觸者追蹤率僅約 45.5%。 西班牙取消 DRC 國家足球隊的世界盃熱身賽;美國要求 DRC 國家足球隊在入境參與世界盃前,必須先完成 21 天隔離。
z8yLb29WscLB_zR8c2jXyQ.en: DRC outbreak update: as of 2 June, 363 confirmed cases have been reported (62 deaths, 6 recovered), concentrated in 25 health zones across Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu provinces. Within the heavily affected Ituri Province, Mambasa health zone has been newly added. DRC's contact tracing rate is only about 45.5%. Spain has cancelled the DRC national football team's World Cup warm-up match. The United States requires the DRC national football team to complete 21 days of quarantine before entering to take part in the World Cup.

_XeGLaqwz_R8n5GpQ_f1IQ.zh: 剛果民主共和國(DRC)疫情更新,迄至 6/1 累計 344 例確定病例(60 例死亡、6 例康復),目前尚有 289 例待確定之疑病例,疫情主要集中在伊圖里省、北基伍與南基伍省共 24 個衛生區。 烏干達疫情更新,迄至 6/2 累計 15 例確定病例 (1 例死亡),其中新增的 6 例病例均為確定個案之密切接觸者。 WHO 表示剛果民主共和國(DRC)近期疑病例數下降,此與疑病例經調查或檢測後被排除有關。
_XeGLaqwz_R8n5GpQ_f1IQ.en: DRC outbreak update: as of 1 June, 344 confirmed cases have been reported (60 deaths, 6 recovered), and 289 suspected cases remain pending confirmation. The outbreak is concentrated in 24 health zones across Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu provinces. Uganda outbreak update: as of 2 June, it had 15 cumulative confirmed cases (1 death); the six newly added cases were all close contacts of confirmed cases. WHO said the number of suspected cases in DRC has recently declined, due to suspected cases being ruled out after investigation or testing.

E5OUYwmPNlbc9R4BBSFotg.zh: WHO 公布全球今年截至 4/26 累計報告 7 萬 9,740 例病例,1,010 例死亡,其中,4 月新增病例數較今年 3 月下降 54%,且較去年同期下降 62%,各國 CFR 介於 0-8.9%。病例分布於東地中海、非洲、東南亞及美洲共 22 個國家,近期新增病例以剛果民主共和國、阿富汗、安哥拉及南蘇丹為多。WHO 評估約有 10 億人口面臨感染風險,全球傳播風險為非常高。
E5OUYwmPNlbc9R4BBSFotg.en: WHO reports that globally, as of 26 April this year, 79,740 cases and 1,010 deaths have been reported cumulatively. New cases in April fell 54% from March this year and 62% from the same period last year. CFR across countries ranges from 0% to 8.9%. Cases are distributed across 22 countries in the Eastern Mediterranean, Africa, South-East Asia and the Americas. Recent new cases are mainly in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Afghanistan, Angola and South Sudan. WHO estimates that about 1 billion people face infection risk, and the global transmission risk is very high.

iEW_w2TlxI8XzGdu0jUQHg.zh: 剛果民主共和國(DRC)疫情更新,迄至5/31累計321例確定病例(48例死亡、6例康復),目前尚有220例待確認之疑病例。 烏干達疫情更新,迄至5/31累計9確定病例 (1例死亡),個案分布於首都坎帕拉(Kampala)及瓦基索區(Wakiso),與跨境移動與醫療照護暴露有關。 巴西報告2例疑病例,其中1例具剛果民主共和國旅遊史,經檢驗為流行性腦脊髓膜炎及瘧疾,已排除伊波拉病毒感染。
iEW_w2TlxI8XzGdu0jUQHg.en: DRC outbreak update: as of 31 May, 321 confirmed cases had been reported (48 deaths, 6 recovered), and 220 suspected cases remain pending confirmation. Uganda outbreak update: as of 31 May, 9 cumulative confirmed cases (1 death) had been reported, distributed across the capital Kampala and Wakiso District, linked to cross-border movement and healthcare exposure. Brazil reported two suspected cases; one had recent travel history to the DRC. Testing identified meningitis and malaria, and Ebola virus infection has been ruled out.

6eIB_85kWZQUTi9tXP5T8A.zh: 剛果民主共和國(DRC)疫情更新,迄至5/30累計282例確診病例(42例死亡、2例康復),目前尚有321例待確認之疑病例。疫情主要集中在伊圖里省、北基伍與南基伍省共22個衛生區。另烏干達目前9例確診病例 (1例死亡)。 巴西當局於聖保羅與里約熱內盧監測2名伊波拉疑個案:案1為近期自DRC入境之DRC籍男性,案2為近期自烏干達入境之比利時籍男性。兩案雖已分別確診腦膜炎與瘧疾,惟尚未排除伊波拉病毒共感染之可能性,目前均已隔離並等待檢驗結果。 WHO秘書長譚德塞於5/30親赴DRC伊圖里省重災區視察,強調妥善治療可提高存活率。
6eIB_85kWZQUTi9tXP5T8A.en: DRC outbreak update: as of 30 May, 282 confirmed cases (42 deaths, 2 recovered) had been reported, and 321 suspected cases remain pending confirmation. The outbreak is concentrated in 22 health zones across Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu provinces. Uganda currently has nine confirmed cases (1 death). Brazilian authorities are monitoring two suspected Ebola cases in São Paulo and Rio de Janeiro: case 1 is a DRC national man who recently entered Brazil from the DRC, and case 2 is a Belgian man who recently entered from Uganda. Although they were diagnosed with meningitis and malaria respectively, Ebola virus co-infection has not been ruled out, and both are isolated awaiting test results. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visited the hard-hit area of Ituri Province, DRC, on 30 May and stressed that proper treatment can improve survival.

TrNrnQecC4af-YR-nwzsMQ.zh: 每月更新:  全球自2022 年截至今年4/30 累計144 國/地區報告18 萬4,531例確診病例,其中,至少506例死亡。 非洲地區近6週(4/6-5/17)通報確診病例數最高國家:馬達加斯加(780例)、幾內亞(40例)、南蘇丹(37例)、剛果民主共和國(35例)、肯亞(27例)、賴比瑞亞(17例)。 全球近6週(4/6-5/17)共有19個國家報告 Ib型病毒:   社區傳播共15國:馬達加斯加(780例)、南蘇丹(37例)、剛果民主共和國(35例)、巴基斯坦(29例)、肯亞(27例)、西班牙(18例)、德國(17例)、瑞士(14例)、葛摩/葡萄牙(6例)、斯洛伐克/剛果共和國(4例)、哥倫比亞(3例)、泰國/丹麥(2例)。 與旅遊相關(境外移入)共4 國:美國(5 例)、模里西斯(2 例)、臺灣/愛爾蘭(1例)。
TrNrnQecC4af-YR-nwzsMQ.en: Monthly update: globally, since 2022 and as of 30 April this year, 144 countries and territories have reported 184,531 confirmed cases, of which at least 506 were fatal. In Africa, the countries reporting the most confirmed cases over the past six weeks (6 April–17 May) were Madagascar (780), Guinea (40), South Sudan (37), the DRC (35), Kenya (27) and Liberia (17). Globally, 19 countries have reported clade Ib virus over the past six weeks (6 April–17 May). Community transmission has been reported in 15 countries: Madagascar (780), South Sudan (37), DRC (35), Pakistan (29), Kenya (27), Spain (18), Germany (17), Switzerland (14), Comoros/Portugal (6), Slovakia/Republic of the Congo (4), Colombia (3), and Thailand/Denmark (2). Travel-associated (imported) cases have been reported in four countries: United States (5), Mauritius (2), and Taiwan/Ireland (1).

ULj2saUhIIjkx-wC-Z0uuQ.zh: 剛果民主共和國(DRC)疫情更新,截至5/28累計報告1,039例病例及242例死亡,分別為906例疑病例(其中223例疑死亡)、133例確診病例(其中19例確診死亡)。疫情主要集中在伊圖里省,並波及北基伍與南基伍省共13 個衛生區,其中Bunia、Rwampara、Mongbwalu、Nyankunde個案數較多。此外,近期檢驗量能提升促使病例重新分類,致下修疑病例數,另位於Rwampara 的治療中心有首例治癒個案。烏干達確診病例增加至9例(其中1例死亡),個案分布於首都Kampala及Wakiso,與跨境移動與醫療照護暴露有關。 WHO於5/28建議3款治療藥物作為 (Bundibugyo virus disease,BVD)臨床試驗評估,並推薦1款口服抗病毒藥物作為暴露後預防之臨床試驗評估、以及2款候選疫苗作為開發評估。 WHO專家推測爆發疫情可能與DRC當地獵捕與食用野味習慣有關,另肯亞法院暫停美國專屬醫療設施計畫。
ULj2saUhIIjkx-wC-Z0uuQ.en: DRC outbreak update: as of 28 May, 1,039 cases and 242 deaths had been reported cumulatively, comprising 906 suspected cases (223 suspected deaths) and 133 confirmed cases (19 confirmed deaths). The outbreak is mainly concentrated in Ituri Province and has spread to 13 health zones in North Kivu and South Kivu provinces; Bunia, Rwampara, Mongbwalu and Nyankunde have the most cases. Recent increases in testing capacity have led to reclassification of cases, which lowered the suspected case count. A first cured case has also been recorded at the treatment centre in Rwampara. Uganda's confirmed cases increased to nine (one death), distributed across the capital Kampala and Wakiso, linked to cross-border movement and healthcare exposure. On 28 May, WHO recommended three therapeutic drugs for clinical trial evaluation in Bundibugyo virus disease (BVD), one oral antiviral drug for clinical trial evaluation as post-exposure prophylaxis, and two candidate vaccines for development evaluation. WHO experts suspect the outbreak may be linked to local bushmeat hunting and consumption practices in the DRC. Separately, a Kenyan court has suspended a US-exclusive medical facility programme.

FuUWemIwCT8_pR68beLbGA.zh: 剛果民主共和國(DRC),截至5/26累計報告1,077例疑病例(其中238人死亡)、121例確診病例(其中17例死亡)。重災區集中在伊圖里、北基伍與南基伍三省,其中最嚴重的地區為伊圖里省的布亞(Bunia)、魯瓦姆帕拉(Rwampara)及蒙布瓦盧(Mongbwalu)。另蒙布瓦盧醫院於5/23-25遭襲,至少25名疑BVD病患逃離,其中包括一名確診病例,對當地防疫構成嚴重風險。
FuUWemIwCT8_pR68beLbGA.en: DRC: as of 26 May, 1,077 suspected cases (238 of whom died) and 121 confirmed cases (17 deaths) had been reported cumulatively. The heavily affected areas are concentrated in Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu provinces. The most severe areas are Bunia, Rwampara and Mongbwalu in Ituri Province. In addition, the Mongbwalu hospital was attacked on 23–25 May, and at least 25 suspected BVD patients fled, including one confirmed case, posing a serious risk to local disease control.

x0YgmFJ-i4jFZr08fKzFjw.zh: 剛果民主共和國(DRC)疫情持續攀升,截至5/26累計報告1,011例病例,其中105例確診、233例死亡,致死率(CFR)達23%。加拿大於5/26宣布禁止DRC與烏干達之公民入境,禁令為期90天;泰國5/26宣布自DRC與烏干達入境之旅客須進行21天入境檢疫;印度於各大機場啟動篩檢與監測措施,5/26報告1例自烏干達境外移入之疑病例,於5/27檢驗呈陰性,已排除風險。
x0YgmFJ-i4jFZr08fKzFjw.en: The outbreak in the DRC continues to grow: as of 26 May, 1,011 cases had been reported cumulatively, including 105 confirmed cases and 233 deaths, with a CFR of 23%. On 26 May, Canada announced a 90-day entry ban on citizens of the DRC and Uganda. On the same day, Thailand announced that travellers entering from the DRC and Uganda must undergo 21 days of entry quarantine. India has launched screening and surveillance measures at major airports; on 26 May it reported one suspected case imported from Uganda, which tested negative on 27 May, so the risk was ruled out.

QtLreGnLRjsuNX-GxBG0pw.zh: 剛果民主共和國(DRC)疫情持續擴大,截至5/24累計報告112例確診及11例死亡、906例疑病例及223例疑病例死亡,主要分布於伊圖里省、北基伍省及南基伍省;烏干達迄今累積報告7例確診,其中1例死亡;義大利出現2例疑病例,在烏干達擔任為期三個月的援助工作人員,返回義國後,出現高燒、嘔吐、腹瀉和噁心等疑症狀,經檢測結果為陰性,無確診病例。非洲CDC評估有11個國家面臨傳播風險,包含安哥拉、蒲隆地、中非共和國、南蘇丹、剛果共和國、衣索比亞、肯亞、盧安達、坦尚亞、尚比亞及索馬利亞。
QtLreGnLRjsuNX-GxBG0pw.en: The outbreak in the DRC continues to expand: as of 24 May, 112 confirmed cases and 11 deaths, plus 906 suspected cases and 223 suspected deaths, had been reported cumulatively, mainly in Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu provinces. Uganda has reported seven confirmed cases cumulatively, one of which was fatal. Italy reported two suspected cases involving an aid worker who had spent three months in Uganda. After returning to Italy, the person developed suspected symptoms including high fever, vomiting, diarrhoea and nausea, but tested negative, so there are no confirmed cases in Italy. The Africa CDC assesses that 11 countries face transmission risk: Angola, Burundi, the Central African Republic, South Sudan, the Republic of the Congo, Ethiopia, Kenya, Rwanda, Tanzania, Zambia and Somalia.

sncrUtYerCGCwrfk3ZssMA.zh: 剛果民主共和國(DRC)及烏干達疫情持續擴大,疫情主要分布於DRC伊圖里與北基伍省,兩國截至5/23累計報告91例確診及10例死亡、867例疑病例及204例疑病例死亡,且匡列1,261名接觸者。DRC伊圖里省傳出3名紅十字會志工染病死亡,南基伍省(South Kivu)亦於5/20通報首例28歲死亡確診個案。烏干達迄今累積報告5例確診,其中1例死亡。另南蘇丹澄清其境內疑病例,經檢測結果為陰性,無確診病例。 WHO指出疫情在5/15通報前恐已隱匿傳播數週或數月,導致疫情蔓延至多個省份。非洲CDC評估有10個非洲國家面臨傳播風險,包含安哥拉、蒲隆地、中非共和國、剛果共和國、衣索比亞、肯亞、盧安達、南蘇丹、坦尚亞及尚比亞。 WHO緊急委員會第一次會議臨時建議,評估剛果民主共和國風險為「非常高」,烏干達及區域風險為「高」,全球風險為「低」。建議疫區國家啟動國家災害或突發事件管理機制,並執行包括加強監測等防控措施;區域層級國家應建立與地方各層級相銜接的國家協調機制制定相關措施;其他國家對來自已記錄到病毒(BDBV)感染地區出現不明原因發熱症狀的旅行者進行檢測、評估、報告及管理,執行公眾之疫情風險溝通等。
sncrUtYerCGCwrfk3ZssMA.en: The outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda continues to expand, mainly in Ituri and North Kivu provinces of the DRC. As of 23 May, the two countries had reported 91 confirmed cases and 10 deaths, 867 suspected cases and 204 suspected deaths, and 1,261 contacts had been listed. In Ituri Province, DRC, three Red Cross volunteers were reported to have died after infection. South Kivu Province reported its first confirmed case, a death in a 28-year-old, on 20 May. Uganda has reported five cumulative confirmed cases, one of which was fatal. South Sudan clarified that a suspected case in its territory tested negative, so there are no confirmed cases there. WHO notes that the outbreak may have spread silently for several weeks or months before it was reported on 15 May, leading to spread across multiple provinces. The Africa CDC assesses that 10 African countries face transmission risk: Angola, Burundi, the Central African Republic, the Republic of the Congo, Ethiopia, Kenya, Rwanda, South Sudan, Tanzania and Zambia. The first meeting of the WHO Emergency Committee provisionally assessed the risk as very high for the DRC, high for Uganda and at regional level, and low globally. It recommends that affected countries activate national disaster or emergency management mechanisms and implement control measures, including enhanced surveillance; that countries in the region establish national coordination mechanisms linked to local levels; and that other countries test, assess, report and manage travellers with unexplained fever who have been in areas where Bundibugyo virus (BDBV) infection has been recorded, and communicate public health risks.

4JYnnMhmWMET4Rx7DVWnyQ.zh: 剛果民主共和國(DRC)及烏干達疫情急遽擴大,截至5/20累計報告近600例疑與139死亡病例,南蘇丹亦通報1例疑個案,跨國傳播風險驟升。由於目前DRC面臨武裝衝突、大量人口流離失所,加上檢體運送困難,當局表示可能嚴重低估通報病例數。另烏干達已宣布取消年度大型慶典「殉道者節」。
4JYnnMhmWMET4Rx7DVWnyQ.en: The outbreak in the DRC and Uganda is expanding rapidly: as of 20 May, nearly 600 suspected cases and 139 deaths had been reported cumulatively. South Sudan has also reported one suspected case, and the risk of cross-border spread has sharply increased. Because the DRC is facing armed conflict and mass displacement, and sample transport is difficult, authorities say case numbers may be seriously underreported. Uganda has also announced the cancellation of its annual major celebration, Martyrs' Day.

jx3mn-Nrpz3EGmvn1QJa-g.zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於5/7-13期間,cVDPV1新增衣索比亞4例;cVDPV2新增3國共10例,分別為奈及利亞6例、剛果民主共和國3例及蘇丹1例;環境樣本部分,WPV1新增巴基斯坦9件。
jx3mn-Nrpz3EGmvn1QJa-g.en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that between 7 and 13 May, cVDPV1 added four cases in Ethiopia; cVDPV2 added 10 cases across three countries: six in Nigeria, three in the DRC and one in Sudan. For environmental samples, WPV1 added nine specimens in Pakistan.

li3DvePBCjIv33xp7VsgJQ.zh: 剛果民主共和國(DRC)伊圖里省(Ituri)爆發邦迪布焦伊波拉病毒(Bundibugyo virus disease, BVD)疫情(資料更新),截至5/19死亡數累計達136例,疑病例逾543例。英國專家以模型推估本次疫情規模可能是現有病例數的1-2倍。
li3DvePBCjIv33xp7VsgJQ.en: A Bundibugyo virus disease (BVD) outbreak has occurred in Ituri Province, DRC (data updated). UK experts using modelling estimate that the true size of this outbreak could be one to two times the number of existing cases.

qgAy5d7t9-x2crzVopEWWQ.zh: 剛果民主共和國(DRC)伊圖里省(Ituri)爆發邦迪布焦伊波拉病毒(Bundibugyo virus disease, BVD)疫情(資料更新),當地於24小時內新增26例疑死亡病例,死亡數累計達131例,另已通報516例疑病例及33例確診病例。該國北基伍省布滕博市於5/18通報首例確診病例。
qgAy5d7t9-x2crzVopEWWQ.en: A Bundibugyo virus disease (BVD) outbreak has occurred in Ituri Province, DRC (data updated). Within 24 hours, 26 new suspected deaths were recorded, bringing cumulative deaths to 131. A total of 516 suspected cases and 33 confirmed cases have been reported. In North Kivu Province, Butembo city reported its first confirmed case on 18 May.

iM4K28pPvtsQd-92RSVmRw.zh: 剛果民主共和國(DRC)伊圖里省(Ituri)爆發邦迪布焦伊波拉病毒(Bundibugyo virus disease, BVD)疫情(資料更新),據報導至少6名美國公民為高風險接觸者,其中1人有症狀,美國當局已介入協助。
iM4K28pPvtsQd-92RSVmRw.en: A Bundibugyo virus disease (BVD) outbreak has occurred in Ituri Province, DRC (data updated). Reports indicate that at least six US citizens are high-risk contacts, one of whom has symptoms, and US authorities have become involved to provide assistance.

1mAaN_KF48TojEYpQDPn9g.zh: WHO於5/17宣布剛果民主共和國(DRC)及烏干達發生由Bundibugyo病毒(BVD)感染引起之疫情為「國際關注公共衛生緊急事件」(PHEIC),惟尚未達「全球大流行緊急事件」(pandemic emergency)。DRC伊圖里省於5/5報告出現一種高致死率的不明原因疾病,5/15證實為Bundibugyo病毒造成此次疫情發生。首例已知病例為4/25出現症狀之醫護人員。伊圖里省截至5/16累計報告246例疑病例及80例死亡病例(疑),其中8例確診,已對接觸者進行追蹤調查。病例年齡介於20至39歲間,女性佔60%以上,主要分別於姆萬帕拉衛生區及蒙布瓦盧衛生區。 烏干達於5/15向WHO報告1例境外移入確診病例,為59歲DRC男性居民,5/11前往烏干達並於坎帕拉住院治療,5/14在加護病房中因出血症狀死亡,5/15證實為Bundibugyo病毒感染。該國坎帕拉於5/15-16累計報告2例確診病例(其中1例死亡),目前2者間無明確流行病學關聯,迄無證據顯示烏干達境內發生本土傳播。 本次疫情為DRC自1976年以來發生的第17次疫情,前一次疫情發生於2025年9/4-12/1,累計報告64例病例(53例確診)及45例死亡,前一次由Bundibugyo病毒造成之疫情發生於2012年8/17-11/26,累計報告59例病例(38例確診)及34例死亡。WHO評估本次疫情存在臨床警覺性低、多種病原共存、院內感染、地緣政治、追蹤困難及疫情已跨國傳播等複雜因素,並研判目前疫情主要集中於非洲特定地區,雖已有跨國個案,惟不建議實施旅遊或貿易限制,評估於國家及區域層級之公共衛生風險為高,於全球之風險則為低。
1mAaN_KF48TojEYpQDPn9g.en: On 17 May, WHO declared the Bundibugyo virus disease (BVD) outbreak in the DRC and Uganda a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC), but not a pandemic emergency. Ituri Province in the DRC reported an unexplained high-fatality illness on 5 May; on 15 May it was confirmed to be caused by Bundibugyo virus. The first known case was a health-care worker with symptom onset on 25 April. As of 16 May, Ituri had reported 246 suspected cases and 80 suspected deaths, of which eight were confirmed, and contacts are being followed up. Cases were aged 20–39, with women making up more than 60%, and were mainly in Mwampala and Mongbwalu health zones. On 15 May, Uganda reported to WHO one imported confirmed case: a 59-year-old DRC male resident who travelled to Uganda on 11 May and was hospitalised in Kampala. He died of haemorrhagic symptoms in intensive care on 14 May, and BDBV infection was confirmed on 15 May. Kampala reported two confirmed cases cumulatively on 15–16 May, one of them fatal. There is no clear epidemiological link between the two, and there is no evidence of local transmission in Uganda. This is the 17th DRC outbreak since 1976. The previous outbreak ran from 4 September to 1 December 2025, with 64 cases (53 confirmed) and 45 deaths. The previous outbreak caused by Bundibugyo virus ran from 17 August to 26 November 2012, with 59 cases (38 confirmed) and 34 deaths. WHO notes complex factors, including low clinical awareness, multiple pathogens circulating together, nosocomial infection, geopolitical issues, difficulties in contact tracing and cross-border spread. It assesses that the outbreak is currently concentrated in specific areas of Africa and, although there are cross-border cases, does not recommend travel or trade restrictions. WHO assesses the public health risk as high at national and regional levels and low globally.

sSGfCo8Hdi5E4sG8tnhkXg.en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that between 23 and 29 April, cVDPV2 added four cases across three countries: two in Chad, and 21 each in the DRC and Nigeria. For environmental samples, WPV1 added six specimens in Pakistan, and cVDPV2 added two specimens across two countries, one each in Malawi and Nigeria. In mid-April, one cVDPV2 environmental sample was detected in Perth, Western Australia. Its genetic sequence is similar to viruses detected in recent years in Africa, Europe and Papua New Guinea. Because local vaccination coverage reaches 92% and there are no signs of community transmission, authorities assess the risk as very low and speculate that the virus may have been excreted into the sewage system by someone who travelled abroad. The country's most recent human case occurred in 1972.

BDmH8dd92cYbJ_CO-k6Qpw.en: WHO reports that globally, as of 29 March this year, 58,740 cases and 732 deaths have been reported cumulatively. New cases in March fell 17% from February this year and 56% from the same period last year. CFR across countries ranges from 0% to 9.7%. Cases are distributed across 22 countries and territories in the Eastern Mediterranean, Africa, South-East Asia and the Americas. Recent new cases are mainly in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Afghanistan and Mozambique. WHO estimates that about 1 billion people face infection risk, and the global risk of spread is very high.

qKUxc6-Q6_UeTClgmVK8Jw.zh: 每月更新:  全球自2022年截至今年3/31累計144國/地區報告18萬2,945例確診病例,其中,至少503例死亡。 今年3月共計48國家/地區報告1,235 例新增確診病例,其中5例死亡(CFR 0.4%),70.4%的病例來自非洲地區,相較今年2月,東地中海及西太平洋區病例數上升,其餘地區疫情下降,哥倫比亞、丹麥、厄瓜多和新加坡通報首例 Ib 型病例。 非洲地區近6週(2026/3/9-4/19)共計16國通報969例確診病例,其中3例死亡(CFR 0.3%),以馬達加斯加、剛果民主共和國、幾內亞、肯亞、蒲隆地為高;非洲以外地區,阿根廷、丹麥、德國、巴基斯坦、葡萄牙、新加坡、西班牙及英國已持續出現Ib型社區傳播。 巴基斯坦信德省通報一起院內群聚事件(前已掌握),傳播原因主要為共用保溫箱、氧氣設備及設備表面受污染。在3至4月期間,該省9縣(/30縣)共29例確診與8例死亡(CFR 28%),死亡個案均為6個月以下嬰兒,基因定序確認為Ib型變異株。
qKUxc6-Q6_UeTClgmVK8Jw.en: Monthly update: globally, since 2022 and as of 31 March this year, 144 countries and territories have reported 182,945 confirmed cases cumulatively, of which at least 503 died. In March this year, 48 countries and territories reported 1,235 new confirmed cases, including five deaths (CFR 0.4%). 70.4% of cases came from the African region. Compared with February, cases rose in the Eastern Mediterranean and Western Pacific regions and fell in other regions. Colombia, Denmark, Ecuador and Singapore reported their first clade Ib cases. In the African region, over the past six weeks (9 March–19 April), 16 countries reported 969 confirmed cases, including three deaths (CFR 0.3%), with the highest numbers in Madagascar, the DRC, Guinea, Kenya and Burundi. Outside Africa, Argentina, Denmark, Germany, Pakistan, Portugal, Singapore, Spain and the United Kingdom have continued to show clade Ib community transmission. Sindh Province in Pakistan reported a hospital cluster (already known), with transmission mainly attributed to shared incubators and oxygen equipment and contaminated equipment surfaces. In March and April, the province's nine of 30 districts recorded 29 confirmed cases and eight deaths (CFR 28%). All deaths were in infants under six months, and genetic sequencing confirmed a clade Ib variant.

z4Gj91ovG_ErvuhbfJMUUw.zh: WHO非洲區今年截至第 15 週累計報告 6,929 例疑病例,以剛果民主共和國、日、布吉納法索為多,其中 340 例死亡。報告病例中,700例經實驗室檢驗出病原體,其中包含腦膜炎雙球菌C型(39.7%)、肺炎鏈球菌(33.7%)、腦膜炎雙球菌 W 型(15.3%)及 b 型流感嗜血桿菌(5.6%)等。
z4Gj91ovG_ErvuhbfJMUUw.en: WHO's African Region has reported 6,929 suspected cases cumulatively through week 15 this year, mainly in the DRC, Niger and Burkina Faso, including 340 deaths. Of the reported cases, 700 were confirmed by laboratory testing to have a pathogen, including Neisseria meningitidis serogroup C (39.7%), Streptococcus pneumoniae (33.7%), N. meningitidis serogroup W (15.3%) and Haemophilus influenzae type b (5.6%), among others.

6f9zc5fknSBFAHZi6pNvuQ.zh: 日本疫情急遽上升,今年截至4/22累計報告362例,高於去(2025) 年全年病例數(265 例),分布以東京都(153 例)、神奈川縣(36 例)、鹿兒島縣(34 例)、千葉縣(24 例)及愛知縣(23 例)為多,其中 33 例為境外移入病例,59%病患未接種疫苗或接種史不明。 孟加拉自今年 3/15 疫情爆發,截至 4/17 累計報告逾 3 萬例疑病例(含 4,460 例確診),其中 251 例病例死亡(含 42 例確診),疫情目前已擴及全國,當局目前亦面臨檢測試劑短缺問題。 巴基斯坦今年截至 3 月累計報告 4,541 例確定病例及 71 例兒童死亡病例,其中以北部開伯爾-普什圖省(1,712 例)、中部旁遮普省(1,198 例)及東南部信德省(1,183 例)為多,此次疫情係因該國於COVID-19 流行期間中斷預防接種作業而產生大量未接種疫苗兒童族群所致,當局刻正規劃擴大預防接種作業。 剛果民主共和國東部南基伍省今年累計報告 10,065 例確定病例及 72 例死亡病例,死亡病例多發生於交通不便地區,當局已提供免費醫療及疫苗接種服務。
6f9zc5fknSBFAHZi6pNvuQ.en: Japan: the outbreak has risen sharply, with 362 cases reported cumulatively as of 22 April this year, exceeding last year's full-year total (265 cases). Cases are concentrated in Tokyo Metropolis (153), Kanagawa Prefecture (36), Kagoshima Prefecture (34), Chiba Prefecture (24) and Aichi Prefecture (23). Of these, 33 were imported, and 59% of patients were unvaccinated or had unknown vaccination history. Bangladesh: since the outbreak began on 15 March this year, more than 30,000 suspected cases (including 4,460 confirmed) have been reported cumulatively as of 17 April, of which 251 died (including 42 confirmed). The outbreak has now spread across the country, and authorities face a shortage of testing reagents. Pakistan: as of March this year, 4,541 confirmed cases and 71 child deaths had been reported cumulatively. Cases are concentrated in the northern Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Province (1,712), central Punjab Province (1,198) and south-eastern Sindh Province (1,183). The outbreak is attributed to the large number of unvaccinated children created when immunisation was suspended during the COVID-19 pandemic, and authorities are planning to expand immunisation. DRC: South Kivu Province in eastern DRC has reported 10,065 confirmed cases and 72 deaths cumulatively this year. Most deaths occurred in areas with poor transport access, and authorities have provided free medical care and vaccination services.

VQp6ZD1D0780o7H79faZ7A.zh: 剛果民主共和國於4/2正式宣布結束國家公共衛生緊急狀態。ACDC報告自2024年1月迄2026年3月,該國26省累計報告近16萬例個案,至少有2,267例死亡,其中3萬7,000例確診。此波疫情流行株為Ib型病毒,當局加強疫情監測與擴大高風險族群之疫苗接種,疫情於2025年高峰期單週報告約2,400例,迄2026年4月約170例/週,降幅逾90%。 厄瓜多報告首例Ib型境外移入確診病例,近期有旅遊史,該國已發布警報並向PAHO申請首批疫苗,目前尚無社區傳播風險,將持續加強接觸者追蹤及疫情監測。 巴基斯坦南部信德省海爾布爾縣報告首起Ib型本土院內群聚事件。該地區自3月中旬起持續出現多起疑/確定病例,包括新生兒感染,迄已通報至少7例新生兒病例,其中至少4例確定病例死亡,惟死者亦多具早產、營養不良及體重過輕等病史。當局調查醫院未確實消毒嬰兒保溫箱,導致交叉感染所致,已關閉新生兒加護病房,並啟動接觸者追蹤。另周邊蘇庫爾縣亦有24例疑病例調查中。
VQp6ZD1D0780o7H79faZ7A.en: The Democratic Republic of the Congo officially declared the end of its national public health emergency on 2 April. Africa CDC reports that from January 2024 to March 2026, 26 provinces of the country cumulatively reported nearly 160,000 cases and at least 2,267 deaths, of which 37,000 were confirmed. The epidemic strain is clade Ib virus. Authorities have strengthened outbreak surveillance and expanded vaccination of high-risk groups. Weekly reports peaked at about 2,400 cases in 2025 and had fallen to about 170 per week by April 2026, a decline of more than 90%. Ecuador has reported its first imported confirmed clade Ib case; the patient had a recent travel history. The country has issued an alert and applied to PAHO for its first batch of vaccines. There is currently no risk of community transmission, and contact tracing and outbreak surveillance will continue to be strengthened. In Khairpur District, Sindh Province, Pakistan, the first locally acquired clade Ib hospital cluster has been reported. Since mid-March, multiple suspected and confirmed cases have continued to occur in the area, including neonatal infections; at least 7 neonatal cases have been reported, of which at least 4 confirmed cases died. Most of the deceased also had histories of premature birth, malnutrition and low birth weight. Authorities' investigation found that hospital infant incubators were not properly disinfected, leading to cross-infection; the neonatal intensive care unit has been closed and contact tracing initiated. In addition, 24 suspected cases are under investigation in neighbouring Sukkur District.

epQxgzy6kwk5queoap9Urw.en: The WHO reports that globally, as of 22 February this year, 36,953 cases and 451 deaths have been reported cumulatively. Compared with January this year, new cases in February fell by 3%, and were 50% lower than the same period last year; case fatality rates in countries range from 0–10%. Cases have been reported in 21 countries and regions across the Eastern Mediterranean, African, South-East Asian and American regions. Recent new cases are concentrated in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Afghanistan and Mozambique. WHO estimates that about 1 billion people are at risk of infection, and the global transmission risk is very high.

GmQvkuk1n4YSJS05K7Vxmg.en: Monthly update: Since 2022 and up to 28 February this year, 144 countries and regions have reported more than 181,000 confirmed cases cumulatively, of which at least 492 died. In February this year, 46 countries and regions reported 1,184 new confirmed cases, including 4 deaths; 58.6% came from the African Region. Compared with January this year, case numbers rose in the European Region, while other regions declined or held steady. Argentina, Austria and the Central African Republic reported their first clade Ib cases. In the African Region over the past six weeks (1 February–15 March 2026), 17 countries reported 907 confirmed cases, including 7 deaths; the highest numbers were in Madagascar, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Kenya, Burundi and Liberia. Outside Africa, Austria, Belgium, Portugal, Spain and the United Kingdom have continued to report clade Ib community transmission.

aoApAvC_qJ5UJe7J0GYTFg.en: The WHO African Region reported 3,988 suspected cases and 173 deaths as of week 10 this year. Niger and Chad have reached the epidemic threshold, while parts of the Central African Republic, Niger, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Chad and Togo have reached the alert threshold. Of the suspected cases, 312 were tested in the laboratory for pathogens, including Streptococcus pneumoniae (42.9%), Neisseria meningitidis serogroup C (38.5%), Neisseria meningitidis serogroup W (10.9%), non-type b Haemophilus influenzae (1.3%) and others.

eknmSNxvDHM-comQMFBTIQ.en: Kent County in south-east England has reported 13 confirmed cases, of which 11 were hospitalized and 2 died. Investigations found that some patients had visited a club, Club Chemistry, in Canterbury between 5 and 7 March. Patients were mainly university students aged 19–21 years, and several were students at the University of Kent. Authorities have provided preventive antibiotic treatment to club staff and close contacts, and urge the public to seek medical care immediately if they develop suspicious symptoms. In Mangembo district of the central province of the Democratic Republic of the Congo, 24 cases were reported, including 9 deaths (CFR: 37%), with 3 laboratory-confirmed. Most were aged 13–24 years. The outbreak began in late February, and several secondary school students were found with similar symptoms within a short period.

GNOUWAKnZ3BBkYUjFlRlLQ.zh: 剛果民主共和國北基伍省(North Kivu)貝市(Beni)於3/9報告1例疑病例,尚無實驗室檢驗報告,當局已啟動相關防治措施,包含封鎖周邊區域、進行病例調查、接觸者追蹤及感控措施;相較於過去北基伍省、開賽省的爆發疫情案例,本案迄僅通報1例疑病例,尚未達宣告爆發疫情標準。
GNOUWAKnZ3BBkYUjFlRlLQ.en: Beni in North Kivu Province, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, reported one suspected case on 9 March; no laboratory results are yet available. Authorities have launched relevant control measures, including cordoning off surrounding areas, case investigation, contact tracing and infection control measures. Compared with past outbreaks in North Kivu and Kasai provinces, only one suspected case has been reported so far, which does not yet meet the criteria for declaring an outbreak.

gKtBSPfc1u_0vfD75q6LTA.zh: 印今年截至第7週報告572例確定病例,其中4例死亡,另共計11省分報告21起疑(13起確診)疫情,當局已加強監測及調查作業;該國去年報告逾1.1萬確定病例,其中69例死亡。 美國疫情持續,今年截至2/26共28州累計報告1,136例確定病例,其中58例住院,92%病患未接種疫苗或接種史不明,病例數以南卡羅來納州報告653例確定病例為多,其次為猶他州(149例)及佛羅里達州(107例)。USCDC 剛果民主共和國今年截至2/10共26省累計20,231例疑病例,其中238例死亡,去(2025)年同期報告7,491例,其中93例死亡。該國2018年5歲以下孩童疫苗接種率僅57%,當局呼籲家長攜帶孩童至疫苗接種場所完成接種。
gKtBSPfc1u_0vfD75q6LTA.en: Indonesia reported 572 confirmed cases this year through week 7, including 4 deaths. Eleven provinces reported 21 outbreaks (13 confirmed), and authorities have strengthened surveillance and investigation. Last year, Indonesia reported more than 11,000 confirmed cases, including 69 deaths. The United States outbreak continues: as of 26 February this year, 1,136 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively across 28 states, of which 58 were hospitalized; 92% of patients were unvaccinated or had unknown vaccination history. Cases are concentrated in South Carolina, with 653 confirmed cases, followed by Utah (149 cases) and Florida (107 cases) (US CDC). In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, as of 10 February this year, 20,231 suspected cases have been reported cumulatively across 26 provinces, including 238 deaths. In the same period last year, 7,491 cases were reported, including 93 deaths. The country's vaccination coverage among children under 5 years was only 57% in 2018, and authorities urge parents to take children to vaccination sites to complete vaccination.

SydaT1vhYVwa3HYYx6oXHA.en: Monthly update: since 2022 and up to 31 January this year, 144 countries and regions have reported more than 179,000 confirmed cases cumulatively, of which at least 483 died. In January this year, 50 countries and regions reported 1,334 new confirmed cases, including 3 deaths; 66% came from the African Region. Compared with December last year, case numbers rose in the European Region, while other regions declined. Case numbers are declining in all regions globally. Comoros and Réunion reported their first clade Ib cases. In the African Region over the past six weeks (5 January–15 February 2026), 20 countries reported 1,142 confirmed cases, including 4 deaths; the highest numbers were in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Guinea, Madagascar, Liberia and Ghana. Outside Africa, France, Portugal and Spain have continued to report clade Ib community transmission. WHO issued a global rapid risk assessment in February: sexual contact remains the main driver of cross-border spread. The global transmission risk is assessed as moderate; the risk for MSM populations, especially those with non-stable sexual partners, is moderate, and the risk for the general public is low. Globally, two recombinant viruses carrying Ib and IIb gene segments have been reported cumulatively: one in a patient in the United Kingdom with a Southeast Asia travel history, and one in a patient in India with a travel history to Arabian Peninsula countries. Genetic sequencing shows they are the same recombinant strain. WHO notes that actual case numbers may be higher than reported, but the clinical symptoms of the recombinant virus are consistent with ordinary lineages, none have been severe, and contact tracing has found no secondary cases; the overall risk assessment remains unchanged.

nJ1g_tlcYp9US8OjvWQr_w.en: Monthly update: since May 2022 and up to 31 December 2025, 143 countries and areas have reported more than 177,000 confirmed cases globally, including at least 477 deaths. In 2025, 99 countries and areas reported more than 50,000 confirmed cases, including 215 deaths (WHO). In December 2025, 42 countries and areas reported 1,169 new confirmed cases, including 6 deaths; 69% came from the African Region. Compared with November, cases declined in all regions. Czechia, Israel, Madagascar, Nepal and Mayotte (France) reported their first clade Ib cases. In the African Region over the six weeks from 7 December 2025 to 18 January 2026, 15 countries reported 871 confirmed cases and 5 deaths, with the highest numbers in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Guinea, Madagascar, Liberia, Kenya and Ghana. Madagascar has had community transmission of clade Ib since December 2025, beginning with a case without recent travel history, and it has spread rapidly nationwide. Outside Africa, France, Italy and Spain continue to report community transmission of clade Ib; Czechia has one case still under investigation. WHO published Analytical considerations for genomic surveillance of mpox virus, which compiles existing evidence and expert opinion on key considerations for MPXV genomic surveillance, to support the use of pathogen genomics in public health surveillance and response (WHO, 22 January).

WGBESEL7gduXJsRKPB5NYw.en: In Africa, cumulative cases in 2025 up to 21 December exceeded 310,000, of which about 3,000 died. 88% of patients lived in South Sudan, Sudan, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Angola and Nigeria.
