R07oxC-uYwofyX-ew0jY3Q.zh: 本月更新:  全球自2022年5月截至今年11/30累計142國/地區報告17萬5千餘例確診病例,其中至少467例死亡(CFR:0.27%);今年截至11/30累計99國/地區報告5萬餘例確診病例,其中206例死亡(CFR:0.41%)。 今年11月共計48國家/地區報告2,150 例新增確診病例,其中 5例死亡(CFR:0.27%),68%來自非洲地區,相較10月,歐洲區與西太平洋區病例數上升,其餘地區疫情下降。 非洲地區近6週(11/2–12/14)共計19 國通報1,435例確診病例,其中7 例死亡(CFR:0.5%),其中以剛果民主共和國(427例)、幾內亞(330例)、賴比瑞亞(176例)、肯亞(142例)及迦納(107例)為高,除賴比瑞亞外,其餘近期病例數呈下降趨勢,另剛果民主共和國多省同時流行Ia及Ib型,部分省分受安全情勢與人口流動影響監測能力,病例數有低估情形。 非洲以外地區,羅馬亞通報首例 Ib 型境外移入病例,病患為成年男性,於今年8月確診,曾至中國且具高風險行為,入境後即住院隔離,境內未發現接觸者,後續亦無通報病例;西班牙及荷蘭持續出現Ib型社區傳播;英國12/2通報1例境外移入病例,同時檢出Ib 及IIb 型基因片段之 MPXV 重組病毒株,病況為輕症,現階段對該重組病毒株之流行範圍仍缺乏足夠資訊。  評估與建議: WHO於9/5終止「國際關注公共衛生緊急事件(PHEIC)」,但因非洲不同基因型持續流行且監測及診斷能力不足,資金及社區資源缺乏,仍將全球傳播風險評估為中等。此次由於無症狀感染者和疫區旅遊者病例未即時發現,導致Ib型傳播風險持續,非洲外的義大利、荷蘭、葡萄牙、西班牙和美國已被列為Ib型社區傳播區。評估對一般民眾傳播風險為低,惟對MSM群體為中,尤其未固定性伴侶族群,建議各國提高檢驗能力,並完整疫調追蹤,呼籲高風險者接種疫苗。
R07oxC-uYwofyX-ew0jY3Q.en: Monthly update: since May 2022 and up to 30 November 2025, 142 countries and areas have reported more than 175,000 confirmed cases globally, including at least 467 deaths (CFR: 0.27%). In 2025 up to 30 November, 99 countries and areas reported more than 50,000 confirmed cases, including 206 deaths (CFR: 0.41%). In November 2025, 48 countries and areas reported 2,150 new confirmed cases, including 5 deaths (CFR: 0.27%); 68% came from the African Region. Compared with October, cases rose in the European and Western Pacific Regions and declined in other regions. In the African Region, over the past six weeks (2 November–14 December), 19 countries reported 1,435 confirmed cases, including 7 deaths (CFR: 0.5%). The highest numbers were in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (427), Guinea (330), Liberia (176), Kenya (142) and Ghana (107). Except for Liberia, recent case numbers have declined in these countries. In the DRC, multiple provinces are experiencing clade Ia and Ib simultaneously, and in some provinces surveillance capacity is affected by security conditions and population movement, so cases may be underestimated. Outside Africa, Romania reported its first imported clade Ib case, in an adult male diagnosed in August this year who had travelled to China and had high-risk behaviour. He was hospitalised in isolation on arrival, no contacts were identified domestically, and no further cases have been reported. Spain and the Netherlands continue to report clade Ib community transmission. On 2 December, the United Kingdom reported 1 imported case, in which a recombinant MPXV strain containing gene segments of both clade Ib and clade IIb was detected. The case was mild, and there is currently insufficient information on the spread of this recombinant strain. Assessment and recommendations: WHO ended the Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) on 5 September. However, because different genotypes continue to circulate in Africa, surveillance and diagnostic capacity are insufficient, and funding and community resources are lacking, WHO still assesses the global transmission risk as moderate. Because asymptomatic infections and cases among travellers to affected areas were not detected promptly, clade Ib transmission risk persists. Italy, the Netherlands, Portugal, Spain and the United States, outside Africa, have been listed as areas of clade Ib community transmission. The risk to the general public is assessed as low, but as moderate for men who have sex with men (MSM), particularly those with non-fixed sexual partners. Countries are advised to improve testing capacity and complete epidemiological investigation and contact tracing, and high-risk people are urged to get vaccinated.

j_lKeLCnvvYzMb-Zsg-naw.zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於11/27-12/3期間,cVDPV2新增2國共3例,分別為剛果民主共和國2例、安哥拉1例;環境樣本部分,cVDPV2新增2國共9件,分別為巴布亞紐幾內亞7件、查德2件。
j_lKeLCnvvYzMb-Zsg-naw.en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported for 27 November–3 December that cVDPV2 added 3 cases in 2 countries: 2 in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and 1 in Angola. For environmental samples, cVDPV2 added 9 samples in 2 countries: 7 in Papua New Guinea and 2 in Chad.

UNHbWKTQg4Jp81s2zaylwg.zh: WHO公布全球今年截至10月累計報告逾56萬例病例,約7,000例死亡,其中,10月新增報告約3.5萬例,較9月下降34%,各國CFR介於0-8.2%;病例分布於東地中海、非洲、東南亞、美洲、西太平洋共32個國家/地區,近期新增病例以葉門、剛果民主共和國、安哥拉為多,目前口服疫苗庫存量高於緊急需求數。WHO評估約有10億人口面臨感染風險,全球傳播風險為非常高。
UNHbWKTQg4Jp81s2zaylwg.en: The WHO reports that globally, as of October this year, more than 560,000 cases and about 7,000 deaths have been reported cumulatively. In October, about 35,000 new cases were reported, a 34% decrease from September, and national case fatality rates range from 0 to 8.2%. Cases have been distributed across 32 countries and areas in the Eastern Mediterranean, Africa, South-East Asia, the Americas and the Western Pacific. Recent new cases are concentrated in Yemen, the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Angola. Current oral vaccine stocks exceed emergency demand. WHO estimates that about 1 billion people face the risk of infection, and the global transmission risk is very high.

9Vd2aMvXvFqNbKA6J13MqQ.zh: 剛果民主共和國宣布中部開賽省疫情結束,最後1例確診者已於10/19康復,42天內無新增病例,該國自9/4報告首例截至11/30累計6區53例確診及11例疑病例,其中45例死亡(CFR:70.3%),此波疫情已有 5名醫護人員感染(3人死亡)。此為該國第16次爆發疫情,由於該國面臨多種疾病疫情,亦長期政治經濟不穩定,對疫情應對能力有限,未來仍可能有地方性流行。
9Vd2aMvXvFqNbKA6J13MqQ.en: The Democratic Republic of the Congo has declared the end of its outbreak in Kasai-Central province, after the last confirmed patient recovered on 19 October and no new cases were reported for 42 days. Since the first case was reported on 4 September, a cumulative total of 53 confirmed and 11 suspected cases have been recorded across six health zones as of 30 November, of which 45 died (CFR 70.3%). Five health workers have been infected in this outbreak, three of whom died. This is the country's 16th Ebola outbreak. Given multiple concurrent disease outbreaks and long-standing political and economic instability, its capacity to respond is limited, and localized transmission may still occur in the future.

Jck0sanvCqCNsPyfily28w.zh: 美國今年截至11/29共43州報告1,798例,其中212例住院、3例死亡,並報告46起疫情,92%病患未接種疫苗或接種史不明,近期疫情集中於猶他/亞利桑那/南卡羅來納州。 波蘭東南部喀爾巴阡山脈地區共計4縣市今年截至11/30累計報告18例病例,其中8例住院治療,該國第1及2劑疫苗接種率低於WHO建議之95%,當地社區持續傳播,與鄰國有跨境傳播及發生大規模疫情風險,當局已啟動疫情調查及接觸者監測作業。 非洲疫情更新,剛果民主共和國今年截至8/30報告逾5萬例確定病例,其中794例死亡,無國界醫生組織(MSF)於北基伍省4-11月共計2區報告3,051例病例,其中1,111例出現併發重症,MSF持續進行大規模疫苗接種作業,惟武裝衝突致疫情控制困難;烏干達東北部納帕克區11/19爆發疫情,截至11/28累計報告74例病例,其中11例兒童死亡。
Jck0sanvCqCNsPyfily28w.en: United States: As of 29 November this year, 1,798 cases had been reported from 43 states, including 212 hospitalizations and 3 deaths, and 46 outbreaks have been reported. Of the patients, 92% were unvaccinated or had an unknown vaccination history. Recent outbreaks are concentrated in Utah, Arizona and South Carolina. Poland: In the Carpathian Mountains region of south-eastern Poland, four counties reported a cumulative 18 cases as of 30 November this year, 8 of whom were hospitalized. Poland's first and second dose vaccination coverage is below the 95% recommended by WHO, and local community transmission is ongoing. There is a risk of cross-border spread to neighbouring countries and of large-scale outbreaks, and authorities have launched outbreak investigations and contact monitoring. Africa: The Democratic Republic of the Congo reported more than 50,000 confirmed cases this year as of 30 August, including 794 deaths. Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) reported 3,051 cases in two health zones of North Kivu province from April to November, of which 1,111 developed severe complications. MSF continues large-scale vaccination, but armed conflict makes outbreak control difficult. In north-eastern Uganda, an outbreak began in Napak district on 19 November; as of 28 November, 74 cases had been reported, including 11 child deaths.

3lMiuCORR4TTc2VRMGZW1w.zh: 剛果民主共和國中部開賽省疫情更新,WHO公佈該國最後1名確診病患已於10/19康復出院,倘42天內無新增病例,預計於今(2025)年12月宣布疫情結束;該國自9/4宣布疫情後,累計報告53例確診及11例疑病例,其中43例死亡,19例已康復,另自9/25起,皆未新增報告病例,當局將持續與WHO專家團隊合作落實監測及防疫等相關措施。
3lMiuCORR4TTc2VRMGZW1w.en: Update on Kasai-Central province, Democratic Republic of the Congo: WHO announced that the last confirmed patient was discharged after recovering on 19 October. If no new cases are reported within 42 days, the outbreak is expected to be declared over in December this year. Since the outbreak was declared on 4 September, a cumulative 53 confirmed and 11 suspected cases have been reported, of which 43 died and 19 recovered. No new cases have been reported since 25 September. Authorities will continue to work with WHO's expert team on surveillance and prevention measures.

-C7kcRdM-8ymmrwOJLt4Xw.zh: 剛果民主共和國中部開賽省疫情更新,今(2025)年截至10/1累計報告53例確診病例及11例疑病例,其中42例死亡(CFR:65.6%),當局已匡列逾1,000名接觸者,另逾8,000名醫護人員、病例及接觸者已接種疫苗;WHO表示疫情呈現下降趨勢,疫情傳播僅侷限於特定地區,已不同於疫情初期之院內感染及超級傳播情形,惟仍警告風險仍在,倘未能及時發現並隔離患者,病毒仍可能於家庭或密切接觸者間持續傳播。
-C7kcRdM-8ymmrwOJLt4Xw.en: Kasai-Central province, Democratic Republic of the Congo: As of 1 October this year, 53 confirmed and 11 suspected cases had been reported cumulatively, of which 42 died (CFR 65.6%). Authorities have listed more than 1,000 contacts, and more than 8,000 health workers, cases and contacts have been vaccinated. WHO says the outbreak is declining and transmission is confined to specific areas, unlike the nosocomial infections and superspreading seen in the early stage. However, WHO warns that the risk remains: if patients are not detected and isolated promptly, the virus could continue to spread among family members and close contacts.

FUmgFLRVFPkkHQNqbVsINA.zh: 剛果民主共和國中部開賽省疫情更新,今(2025)年截至9/13累計報告81例確診及疑病例,其中28例死亡(CFR:34.5%),已匡列逾700名接觸者,近期在疫情中心以外地區發現1例新病例。WHO已與該國合作,提供治療性單株抗體及疫苗等防疫物資;本次為該省18年來首次爆發疫情,其個案管理能力不足及道路不便,已成為疫情防治相關工作之挑戰。
FUmgFLRVFPkkHQNqbVsINA.en: Outbreak update for Kasai-Central Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo: as of 13 September this year, 81 confirmed and suspected cases had been cumulatively reported, of which 28 died (CFR: 34.5%). More than 700 contacts have been identified. A new case was recently detected outside the outbreak centre. WHO, in cooperation with the country, has provided therapeutic monoclonal antibodies, vaccines and other response supplies. This is the first outbreak in the province in 18 years; insufficient case management capacity and poor road access have posed challenges to control efforts.

hrpbx6v4Z9owiqcJRR45aw.zh: 剛果民主共和國疫情更新,今年截至9/6累計報告37例,其中15例死亡(CFR:38%),9例住院中,5例為確定病例,匡列157名接觸者,惟有效追蹤僅19.1%,當局表示不安全之埋葬方式、接觸者追蹤不足及人口/接觸者移動為當前疫情控制挑戰,將強化疫情監測及接觸者追蹤等防治措施。
hrpbx6v4Z9owiqcJRR45aw.en: Democratic Republic of the Congo outbreak update: as of 6 September this year, 37 cases had been cumulatively reported, of which 15 died (CFR: 38%). Nine are hospitalized, five of them confirmed cases. 157 contacts have been identified, but effective follow-up is only 19.1%. Authorities state that unsafe burial practices, insufficient contact tracing, and the movement of people and contacts are current challenges to outbreak control, and that surveillance and contact-tracing measures will be strengthened.

te-55ufcQ2ClxQUbcfUTeA.zh: WHO公布全球今年截至7月累計報告約38萬例,4,478例死亡,其中,7月新增報告約6.8萬例、死亡624例,較6月上升14%,各國CFR介於0-11.2%;病例分布於非洲、東地中海、東南亞及美洲共31個國家/地區,以南蘇丹、阿富汗、葉門及剛果民主共和國為多;WHO評估約有10億人口面臨感染風險,全球傳播風險為非常高。
te-55ufcQ2ClxQUbcfUTeA.en: WHO reports that globally, as of July this year, about 380,000 cases and 4,478 deaths have been cumulatively reported. In July alone, about 68,000 new cases and 624 deaths were reported, a 14% increase over June. Case fatality rates across countries range from 0–11.2%. Cases are distributed across 31 countries and regions in Africa, the Eastern Mediterranean, South-East Asia and the Americas, with the most in South Sudan, Afghanistan, Yemen and the Democratic Republic of the Congo. WHO estimates that about one billion people are at risk of infection, and assesses the global transmission risk as very high.

7SH3zz-BkfFeKNDMsecHrA.zh: 墨西哥今年迄今報告逾7,000例疑病例,其中超過3,900例確診及14例死亡,病例數以北部契瓦瓦州逾3,600例為多,且以0-4歲嬰幼兒為主,惟實際病例數可能更高,該國目前疫苗覆蓋率僅76%,當局已啟動監測及接種疫苗計畫。 剛果民主共和國東部南基伍省今年迄今報告4,057例,其中122例死亡(CFR:3%),由於當地交通不便及局勢不穩定,死亡率偏高,當局已規劃疫苗接種計畫。 葉門今年截至7/14累計報告2萬餘例疑病例及178例死亡(CFR: 0.85%),病例集中於西部荷台達省及札馬爾省。
7SH3zz-BkfFeKNDMsecHrA.en: Mexico has reported more than 7,000 suspected cases this year, of which more than 3,900 are confirmed, and 14 deaths. Cases are highest in northern Chihuahua State, with more than 3,600, and are mainly among infants and young children aged 0–4. Actual case numbers may be higher. Mexico's vaccination coverage is only 76%, and authorities have launched a surveillance and vaccination programme. In eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, South Kivu Province has reported 4,057 cases this year, of which 122 died (CFR: 3%). The high mortality is attributed to poor transport and instability in the area, and authorities have planned a vaccination programme. Yemen has reported more than 20,000 suspected cases and 178 deaths cumulatively as of 14 July this year (CFR: 0.85%). Cases are concentrated in Hudaydah and Dhamar governorates in the west.

INK9QIjivlSTTc5aJxESkg.zh: 本月更新:  全球自2022年6月截至今年7/25累計139國/地區報告15萬4千餘例確診病例,其中至少385例死亡(CFR:0.2%)。 全球今年截至第30週累計79國/地區報告3萬3,370例確診病例,其中非洲區2萬8,481例、美洲區2,343例、歐洲區1,706例、西太平洋區755例、東南亞區52例及東地中海區33例。  其他更新:  中國今年截至7/31報告23例Ib型確診病例,其中7例具疫區旅遊史,包含烏干達(2例)、坦尚亞(2例)、剛果民主共和國(2例)、西非國家(剛果、馬利),另2例具泊爾及1例具阿拉伯聯合大公國旅遊史,其餘個案為本土傳播,其中,包含居住在中國之非洲僑民。WHO基於所有通報群聚事件中,指標個案均能與旅遊史有流行病學關聯,故將該國傳播分類由「未知傳播鏈」更正為「與旅遊相關個案」,惟仍無法排除尚未偵測到之社區傳播可能性。當局已在疫區進行廢水監測,並加強衛教及提供無症狀者藥物。 澳大利亞7/19報告新增2例Ib型病例,案1近期有烏干達旅遊史,案2為案1家庭接觸者,當局已加強監測疫情。 英國7/22新增1例Ib型病例,為成年男性,具肯亞旅遊史,當局已展開疫調與監測,並提供接觸者疫苗。  評估與建議: WHO於2025年6月5日召開國際衛生條例(IHR)緊急委員會第四次會議,討論2024年M痘疫情上升的情形。會議確認該事件仍構成國際關注公共衛生緊急事件(PHEIC),並針對受影響國家提出各項臨時建議,包括加強監測、提升診斷能力、推動疫苗接種、改善臨床護理、強化跨境合作,以及加強社區參與和資金支持,並將現行建議延長至2025年8月20日。
INK9QIjivlSTTc5aJxESkg.en: Monthly update: since June 2022 and as of 25 July this year, 139 countries and territories have cumulatively reported more than 154,000 confirmed cases, of which at least 385 died (CFR: 0.2%). This year, as of week 30, 79 countries and territories have cumulatively reported 33,370 confirmed cases: African Region 28,481; Region of the Americas 2,343; European Region 1,706; Western Pacific Region 755; South-East Asia Region 52; and Eastern Mediterranean Region 33. Other updates: China reported 23 confirmed clade Ib cases as of 31 July this year, of which seven had travel history to affected areas, including Uganda (2), Tanzania (2), the DRC (2), and West African countries (Congo, Mali); two had travel history to Nepal and one to the UAE. The other cases were locally transmitted, including African nationals living in China. Based on all reported clusters in which the index cases had epidemiological links to travel, WHO has reclassified China's transmission category from 'unknown transmission chain' to 'travel-associated cases', although undetected community transmission cannot be ruled out. Authorities have launched wastewater surveillance in affected areas, strengthened health education, and provided medicines to asymptomatic people. Australia reported two new clade Ib cases on 19 July: case 1 had recent travel history to Uganda, and case 2 was a household contact of case 1; authorities have strengthened surveillance. The UK reported one new clade Ib case on 22 July, an adult male with travel history to Kenya; authorities have launched epidemiological investigation and surveillance and provided vaccines to contacts. Assessment and recommendations: WHO held the fourth meeting of the IHR Emergency Committee on 5 June 2025 to discuss the rise in mpox since 2024. The meeting confirmed that the event still constitutes a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC), and issued temporary recommendations for affected countries, including strengthening surveillance, improving diagnostic capacity, promoting vaccination, improving clinical care, strengthening cross-border cooperation, and enhancing community engagement and financial support. Current recommendations were extended to 20 August 2025.

JJ420vWXagCIspeEq_2CuA.zh: WHO公布全球今年截至6月累計報告近30.6萬例,3,522例死亡,其中,6月新增報告約6.2萬例、死亡527例,較5月下降21%,各國CFR介於0-8.1%;病例分布於非洲、東地中海及東南亞共28個國家/地區,以南蘇丹、葉門、阿富汗、及剛果民主共和國為多;目前全球口服霍亂疫苗緊急應變庫存290萬劑,低於安全水平(500萬劑),估計約有10億人口面臨感染風險,評估全球傳播風險為非常高。
JJ420vWXagCIspeEq_2CuA.en: WHO reports that as of June this year, nearly 306,000 cases and 3,522 deaths have been reported globally. In June alone, about 62,000 new cases and 527 deaths were reported, a 21% decrease from May. Case fatality ratios range from 0 to 8.1% across countries. Cases were distributed across 28 countries and territories in Africa, the Eastern Mediterranean and South-East Asia, with the most in South Sudan, Yemen, Afghanistan and the Democratic Republic of the Congo. The global emergency stockpile of oral cholera vaccine currently stands at 2.9 million doses, below the safe threshold of 5 million doses. An estimated 1 billion people face a risk of infection, and WHO assesses the global transmission risk as very high.

ZXE4Pq6bJRLSpyW-xQF8_g.zh: 中亞塔吉克今年截至7/1報告41例,當局表示疫情與牲畜食用被炭疽孢子污染之乾草相關,夏季為流行季節,其高危險族群為農產品相關人員,該國2023-24年分別報告80及102例,當局呼籲應加強牲畜屠宰前之檢查措施。 剛果民主共和國東部北基伍省疫情更新,該省4個衛生區截至5/26報告24例疑病例,及動物死亡案例,WHO協助當局啟動跨部門應對措施,強化監測、治療、社區宣導及跨境協調,以控制疫情。
ZXE4Pq6bJRLSpyW-xQF8_g.en: Tajikistan in Central Asia has reported 41 cases as of 1 July this year. Authorities say the outbreak is linked to livestock eating hay contaminated with anthrax spores. Summer is the epidemic season, and the high-risk group is workers involved with agricultural products. The country reported 80 cases in 2023 and 102 in 2024. Authorities call for strengthened inspection of livestock before slaughter. In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, the update for North Kivu Province in the east shows that as of 26 May, four health zones in the province had reported 24 suspected cases and animal deaths. WHO is helping authorities launch a multisectoral response, strengthening surveillance, treatment, community awareness and cross-border coordination to control the outbreak.

O3L01nTaEjL9kZpx2Z_uxg.zh: 非洲疫情更新,獅子山報告自今年初截至6/17累計4,098例確診病例,其中25例死亡(CFR:0.6%),該國已為非洲病例數第三多之國家,僅次剛果民主共和國及烏干達;迦納疫情上升,自今年截至6/18累計117例確診,7成病例分布於該國西部;賴比瑞亞報告今年截至5/31累計69例確診病例,包含IIa及IIb型病例,當局已發布警報,以防止社區及跨境傳播。 美國麻薩諸塞州6/17報告該州首例I型且為該國第5例病例,曾有中非旅遊史,當局研判該國與該州的傳播風險為低。
O3L01nTaEjL9kZpx2Z_uxg.en: Africa update: Sierra Leone has reported 4,098 confirmed cases since the start of this year to 17 June, including 25 deaths (CFR 0.6%), making it the third highest in Africa, after the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda. Ghana's outbreak is rising: 117 confirmed cases since the start of this year to 18 June, with 70% in the west of the country. Liberia has reported 69 confirmed cases this year to 31 May, including clade IIa and IIb cases, and authorities have issued an alert to prevent community and cross-border transmission. United States: on 17 June Massachusetts reported the state's first clade I case, the fifth case in the country, in a person with a history of travel to Central Africa. Authorities assess the transmission risk for the country and the state as low.

pwfW1zb8a9AiNKvBaUHFBA.zh: 剛果民主共和國東北部伊圖里省於去年報告1.3萬例,其中343例死亡;美國堪薩斯州爆發疫情,自去年以來累計68例活動性結核和100例潛伏性結核感染,多數病例為去年5-8月間發現,持續有病例報告,惟對一般民眾風險仍為低。
pwfW1zb8a9AiNKvBaUHFBA.en: Ituri Province in the northeast of the Democratic Republic of the Congo reported 13,000 cases last year, including 343 deaths. In Kansas, USA, an outbreak has occurred: since last year, 68 active tuberculosis cases and 100 latent tuberculosis infections have been reported cumulatively. Most were identified between May and August last year, and cases continue to be reported, but the risk to the general public remains low.

HDUdgM7O3CKOUbza69lsFA.zh: WHO公布全球今年截至4月累計報告已達157,035例,2,148例死亡,其中,4月報告逾3.7萬例病例(死亡561例),較今年3月增加5%,各國CFR介於0-5.3%;病例分布於非洲、東地中海及東南亞共18個國家/地區,以阿富汗、南蘇丹及剛果民主共和國為多,目前全球口服霍亂疫苗緊急應變庫存360萬劑,低於安全水平(500萬劑),估計約有10億人口面臨感染風險,評估全球傳播風險為非常高。
HDUdgM7O3CKOUbza69lsFA.en: WHO reports that as of April this year, 157,035 cases and 2,148 deaths have been reported cumulatively worldwide. In April alone, more than 37,000 cases (561 deaths) were reported, a 5% increase from March this year, with CFRs between 0 and 5.3% across countries. Cases are distributed across 18 countries and regions in Africa, the Eastern Mediterranean and South-East Asia, mainly in Afghanistan, South Sudan and the Democratic Republic of the Congo. The global emergency stockpile of oral cholera vaccine currently stands at 3.6 million doses, below the safety level of 5 million doses. An estimated 1 billion people face a risk of infection. The global transmission risk is assessed as very high.

c4ZCwXOI9KsgYmY6OaV0Ag.zh: 本月更新:  全球自2022年5月截至今年5/29累計133國/地區報告14萬2,367例確診病例,其中至少325例死亡(CFR:0.2%)。 全球今年截至第22週累計74國/地區報告2萬1,655例確診病例,其中,非洲區1萬8,107例、美洲區1,787例、西太平洋區477例、歐洲區1218例、東南亞區37例及東地中海區29例。  其他更新:  非洲烏干達近幾週疫情呈下降趨勢,惟仍嚴峻,每週新增病例數約200例;蒲隆地每週新增病例數持續少於50例。WHO表示剛果民主共和國迄今仍為非洲疫情最嚴重之國家,由於檢測和確診能力下降,可能低報病例數,應審慎評估疫情趨勢。  評估與建議:  WHO於2025/2/25召開針對2024年M痘疫情的IHR緊急委員會第三次會議,表示目前疫情仍嚴峻,剛果民主共和國(DRC)等國疫情規模仍不明確,且國際間報告Ib分支感染國家數倍增,又因資金援助刪減,影響疫苗及診斷資源可近性,故宣布此波疫情持續構成「國際關注公共衛生緊急事件(PHEIC)」。
c4ZCwXOI9KsgYmY6OaV0Ag.en: Monthly update: as of 29 May this year, 133 countries and regions have reported 142,367 confirmed mpox cases cumulatively since May 2022, including at least 325 deaths (CFR 0.2%). As of week 22 this year, 74 countries and regions have reported 21,655 confirmed cases cumulatively this year: 18,107 in the African Region, 1,787 in the Region of the Americas, 477 in the Western Pacific Region, 1,218 in the European Region, 37 in the South-East Asia Region and 29 in the Eastern Mediterranean Region. Other updates: in Africa, the outbreak in Uganda has declined in recent weeks but remains severe, with about 200 new cases per week; new weekly cases in Burundi have remained below 50. WHO says the Democratic Republic of the Congo remains the most affected country in Africa; because testing and diagnostic capacity has declined, case numbers may be underreported, so trends should be assessed with caution. Assessment and recommendations: WHO held the third meeting of the IHR Emergency Committee on the 2024 mpox outbreak on 25 February 2025. It stated that the outbreak remains severe, the scale of the outbreak in countries including the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) remains unclear, the number of countries reporting clade Ib infections has multiplied internationally, and reduced funding is affecting access to vaccines and diagnostic resources. It therefore declared that this wave of the outbreak continues to constitute a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC).

Nfo_A9LwasAwfLVfxp5WLA.zh: 巴西亞馬遜州疫情上升,今年截至4月累計33例病例,多為男性,年齡介於30-39歲,當局將持續採取預防措施,另該州2023年全年僅累計10例病例。其鄰近帕拉州今年截至4/28累計19例病例、其中2例死亡。 獅子山疫情持續,截至5/8累計1,603例確診病例,其中11例死亡,病例多為IIb型男性、年齡介於30-35歲,分布於該國西部,包含首都自由城。另非洲部分高負擔國家,如剛果民主共和國等疫情已趨緩。 英國5/8報告,自2024年10月截至2025年4月30日累計12例Ib型病例,多數病例與疫區旅遊有直接或間接相關。另自2023年截至2025年4月30日累計508例IIb型病例,病例多為MSM族群。
Nfo_A9LwasAwfLVfxp5WLA.en: Brazil's Amazonas State outbreak is rising: as of April this year, 33 cases have been reported cumulatively, mostly in men aged 30–39. Authorities will continue preventive measures. The state reported only 10 cases for the whole of 2023. Neighboring Pará State reported 19 cases as of 28 April this year, including 2 deaths. Sierra Leone's outbreak continues: as of 8 May, 1,603 confirmed cases have been reported cumulatively, including 11 deaths. Most cases are clade IIb men aged 30–35, distributed in the west of the country, including the capital Freetown. Outbreaks in some high-burden African countries, such as the Democratic Republic of the Congo, have slowed. The UK reported on 8 May that from October 2024 to 30 April 2025, 12 clade Ib cases had been reported cumulatively, most of which were directly or indirectly linked to travel to affected areas. In addition, from 2023 to 30 April 2025, 508 clade IIb cases were reported cumulatively, mostly among men who have sex with men (MSM).

ZZXIglZgKSXwpS9_3jf-Gg.zh: 剛果民主共和國北基伍省爆發疫情,截至5/2累計16例疑及1例確診病例,其中1例死亡,主要發生在與烏干達相鄰之愛德華(Edward)湖周圍之4個衛生區,此次疫情亦與烏國西部卡巴萊區報告之7例疑病例具關聯性。當局已加強疾病監測及調查等應對措施,並評估風險及落實兩國之跨境合作。
ZZXIglZgKSXwpS9_3jf-Gg.en: An outbreak has occurred in North Kivu Province of the Democratic Republic of the Congo. As of 2 May, 16 suspected cases and 1 confirmed case had been reported cumulatively, of which 1 died. Cases mainly occurred in 4 health zones around Lake Edward, which borders Uganda. This outbreak is also linked to 7 suspected cases reported in Kabarole District in western Uganda. Authorities have strengthened disease surveillance, investigation and other response measures, assessed the risk, and are implementing cross-border cooperation between the two countries.

9EW7rYzI9WlgEJDXbGbiXQ.zh: WHO於4/22公布全球今年迄3月累計報告11萬6,574例病例,1,514例死亡,其中,3月份報告近3萬3,000例病例,517例死亡(CFR:1.6%),較2月病例/死亡數分別下降9%及8%。病患分布於非洲、東地中海及東南亞區域共22個國家,新增病例數以南蘇丹(7,709例)、阿富汗(7,130例)及剛果民主共和國(5,679例)等為多,WHO評估全球傳播風險為非常高。
9EW7rYzI9WlgEJDXbGbiXQ.en: WHO reported on 22 April that globally, as of March this year, 116,574 cases and 1,514 deaths had been reported cumulatively. In March alone, nearly 33,000 cases and 517 deaths were reported (CFR 1.6%), a decrease of 9% in cases and 8% in deaths compared with February. Cases are distributed across 22 countries in Africa, the Eastern Mediterranean and South-East Asia. The largest numbers of new cases were in South Sudan (7,709), Afghanistan (7,130) and the Democratic Republic of the Congo (5,679). WHO assesses the global transmission risk as very high.

JKSZenwdxlHvEXdeyTAsEg.zh: 非洲疫情更新,今年截至3/30共22國報告逾6,000例,其中325例死亡(CFR:5.4%),主要分布於剛果民主共和國(1,585)及奈及利亞(1,156),另迦納、日及多哥等國之部分地區爆發疫情且超過閾。WHO於4/10發布首份腦膜炎診斷、治療及護理指引,針對流行/非流行地區提供建議,以提供不同國家循證建議及應對措施。
JKSZenwdxlHvEXdeyTAsEg.en: Africa update: as of 30 March this year, 22 countries had reported more than 6,000 cases, of which 325 died (CFR 5.4%). Cases are mainly in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (1,585) and Nigeria (1,156). In addition, parts of Ghana, Niger and Togo have had outbreaks that exceed the epidemic threshold. On 10 April, WHO issued its first guidelines on the diagnosis, treatment and care of meningitis, providing recommendations for endemic and non-endemic areas to give different countries evidence-based advice and response measures.

ALA8XIETwIu5MeA5OjRfQQ.zh: 安哥拉疫情持續且嚴峻,自今年初截至3/23累計16省報告8,543例病例,其中329例死亡(CFR:3.9%),約30%死亡數發生在社區,2月單週病例逾1,000例,達高峰後下降,惟於近期單週再達1,200例高峰。病患分布於盧安達省為多,本戈省次之,多為6-14歲族群(佔21.7%)。WHO表示當地公衛介入措施不足、延遲通報、當地雨季加劇傳播風險,且位處交通要道並與鄰國尚比亞及剛果民主共和國接壤,評估該國和鄰國傳播風險為非常高。另今年迄3/23累計3區署24國報告9 3,172例病例,其中1,197例死亡。
ALA8XIETwIu5MeA5OjRfQQ.en: Angola's outbreak continues and is severe. From the start of the year to 23 March, 8,543 cases and 329 deaths (CFR: 3.9%) were reported from 16 provinces, and about 30% of deaths occurred in the community. Weekly cases exceeded 1,000 in February and then declined after peaking, but recently reached a new weekly peak of 1,200. Most cases are in Luanda Province, followed by Benguela Province; most patients are aged 6–14 years (21.7%). WHO notes insufficient local public health interventions, delayed reporting and rainy-season conditions that increase transmission risk. The country sits on major transport routes and borders Zambia and the Democratic Republic of the Congo. WHO assesses the transmission risk for Angola and its neighbours as very high. Also, from the start of the year to 23 March, 24 countries across 3 WHO regions reported 93,172 cases, of which 1,197 were deaths.

5QgdNMpEdO88hP6db76-yA.zh: 剛果民主共和國3/21更新赤道省班薩庫蘇區(Bansakusu)疫情,於3/10-16期間新增37例病例,其中1例死亡,博洛姆巴區(Bolomba)近期則無新增個案,自1/10-3/16累計2區共2,957例病例,其中58例死亡(CFR:1.96%)。當局證實本次疾病為瘧疾,WHO評估當地公共衛生風險為中,該國與全球風險為低。
5QgdNMpEdO88hP6db76-yA.en: The Democratic Republic of the Congo updated on 21 March on the outbreak in Bansakusu health zone in Équateur Province. Between 10 and 16 March, 37 new cases were reported, including 1 death. Bolomba health zone has had no new cases recently. From 10 January to 16 March, the two health zones reported 2,957 cases cumulatively, with 58 deaths (CFR: 1.96%). Authorities have confirmed the illness is malaria. WHO assesses the local public health risk as moderate, and the risk for the country and globally as low.

jM1M99mu0rPd06_9N3QXWg.zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於3/6-12期間,新增報告cVDPV2型新增3國共7例病例,分別為查德/奈及利亞各3例、剛果民主共和國1例。環境樣本部分,WPV1型陽性樣本新增巴基斯坦18件;cVDPV2型陽性樣本新增3國共8件,分別為查德/巴勒斯坦各3件、坦尚亞2件。
jM1M99mu0rPd06_9N3QXWg.en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that between 6 and 12 March, 7 new cVDPV2 cases were reported in 3 countries: 3 each in Chad and Nigeria, and 1 in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. For environmental samples, 18 new WPV1-positive samples were reported in Pakistan. 8 new cVDPV2-positive samples were reported in 3 countries: 3 each in Chad and Palestine, and 2 in Tanzania.

BqDHhuFXPifR6yMCA8NMTg.zh: 剛果民主共和國班薩庫蘇區(Bansakusu)自2/9-25累計報告1,318例疑病例,其中53例死亡,出現症狀到死亡中位數為1天,平均為2天,目前大約50%檢體的瘧疾檢測呈陽性。WHO依據病例臨床表現和症狀發作到死亡速度,鑑別診斷包括快速發作之細菌性腦膜炎或化學中毒污染,並將當地公共衛生風險評估為中等,國家和全球風險評估為低。
BqDHhuFXPifR6yMCA8NMTg.en: In the Bansakusu health zone of the Democratic Republic of the Congo, 1,318 suspected cases were reported cumulatively between 9 and 25 February, of which 53 died. The median time from symptom onset to death was 1 day, with a mean of 2 days. About 50% of specimens tested positive for malaria. Based on the clinical presentation and the speed from symptom onset to death, WHO's differential diagnoses include rapidly progressing bacterial meningitis and chemical poisoning contamination. WHO assessed the local public health risk as moderate and the national and global risk as low.

qK97Qnts-jQM3Kh_vyYhSg.zh: 非洲疫情上升,ACDC於2/28公布將該病持續列為非洲公共衛生緊急事件(PHECS)。該洲每週平均病例數從2024年8月909例病例持續上升,2025年2月達3,264例;自去年8月非洲宣布PHECS迄今,該病已傳播至另外9個非洲國家。另於剛果民主共和國發現Ia型病毒攜帶 APOBEC3 突變之變異株,具有高度傳播性,並構成重大公共衛生風險。
qK97Qnts-jQM3Kh_vyYhSg.en: Mpox is rising in Africa. On 28 February, the Africa CDC (ACDC) announced that it continues to list the disease as a Public Health Emergency of Continental Security (PHECS). The weekly average number of cases in Africa rose from 909 in August 2024 to 3,264 in February 2025. Since Africa declared the PHECS last August, the disease has spread to 9 more African countries. In the DRC, a clade Ia virus variant carrying APOBEC3 mutations has been found; it is highly transmissible and poses a major public health risk.

k3gWTwDu7yPzKHwlHFQX2Q.zh: 剛果民主共和國赤道省班薩庫蘇(Bansakusu)區與博洛姆巴(Bolomba)區自1月中旬截至2/27累計通報1,096例病例、其中60例死亡;班薩庫蘇區持續新增個案並累計943例病例、其中52例死亡(CFR:5.5%),博洛姆巴區近期則無新增個案,5歲以下兒童佔病例17%,佔死者15.5%,多數症狀包含發燒、畏寒、嘔吐及腹痛等症狀。採檢之571件樣本中,伊波拉與馬堡病毒檢測呈陰性,有309件(54.1%)呈瘧疾陽性。當局刻正調查瘧疾、食物中毒及水汙染等潛在病因。
k3gWTwDu7yPzKHwlHFQX2Q.en: In the Bansakusu and Bolomba health zones of Équateur Province, DRC, 1,096 cases and 60 deaths were reported cumulatively from mid-January to 27 February. Bansakusu continues to add cases, with 943 cases cumulatively, including 52 deaths (CFR: 5.5%). Bolomba has had no new cases recently. Children under 5 account for 17% of cases and 15.5% of deaths. Most patients had symptoms including fever, chills, vomiting and abdominal pain. Of 571 specimens tested, Ebola and Marburg tests were negative, and 309 (54.1%) were positive for malaria. Authorities are investigating potential causes, including malaria, food poisoning and water contamination.

VTQG2Pg18aTuQ7Jr5Cxm_g.zh: 剛果民主共和國南基伍省武裝衝突持續,致使逾400例病例逃離隔離中心,影響該省之監測及防治措施,亦衍伸疫情傳播至鄰國之風險。另非洲已有7國接收到M痘疫苗,其中,5國已接種逾20萬劑疫苗。
VTQG2Pg18aTuQ7Jr5Cxm_g.en: Armed conflict continues in South Kivu Province, DRC. Over 400 cases have escaped from isolation centres, affecting surveillance and control measures in the province and raising the risk of the disease spreading to neighbouring countries. Also, 7 African countries have received mpox vaccines, and 5 of them have administered over 200,000 doses.

NQ84DNSwKvv_cN3yDm0JUA.zh: 剛果民主共和國西北部赤道省近期爆發兩起疫情,分別分布於博洛姆巴區(Bolomba)及班薩庫蘇(Bansakusu)區,於今年1/10至2/15期間累計已報告431例病例、其中53例死亡(CFR:12.3%),個案症狀包括發燒、頭痛、腹瀉、出血熱等,兩起疫情個案間無流行病學關聯,具體傳播途徑均仍調查中,目前已排除伊波拉病毒與馬堡病毒感染。
NQ84DNSwKvv_cN3yDm0JUA.en: Two outbreaks have recently occurred in Équateur Province in northwestern DRC, in the Bolomba and Bansakusu health zones. From 10 January to 15 February this year, 431 cases were reported cumulatively, of which 53 died (CFR: 12.3%). Symptoms included fever, headache, diarrhoea and haemorrhagic fever. The two outbreaks have no epidemiological link, and transmission routes are still under investigation. Ebola and Marburg virus infections have been ruled out.

npg7ZRdXPfRzG1UV_LYAxg.zh: 剛果民主共和國於2/13報告,該國西北部赤道省班薩庫蘇區(Bansakusu) 自2/3-2/9期間新增36例死亡,自疫情爆發以來,累計逾50例死亡,症狀主要為出血熱、頭痛、全身關節痛或腰痛等,當局呼籲民眾遵守衛生措施。
npg7ZRdXPfRzG1UV_LYAxg.en: The Democratic Republic of the Congo reported on 13 February that in the Bansakusu health zone of Équateur Province in the northwest, 36 deaths were newly recorded between 3 and 9 February. Since the outbreak began, over 50 deaths have been recorded cumulatively. Symptoms mainly include haemorrhagic fever, headache, body or joint aches and back pain. Authorities urge the public to follow health measures.

SUbzF8aWQXSkpTUfB8dfFg.zh: 美國分別於1及2月新增報告第2、3例I型病例,案2位於喬治亞州,案3為新罕布夏州,皆自疫區返國後就診確認感染,此2例並無關聯,當局已展開疫調,並建議高風險者接受疫苗,評估一般民眾風險仍為低,有高風險性行為者風險為低至中。 香港報告新增1例病例,37歲男子患有慢性病且有高風險暴露,1/28出現症狀,並於2/4就診,刻正接受隔離,感染源仍在調查中。 UNICEF公布剛果民主共和國於2024年累計64,173例疑病例、14,053例確診、1,341例死亡(CFR:2.08%),自2024年10月中旬通報病例數有下降趨勢,惟確診數仍在波動中,12月單週平均通報病例數降至2,500例以下,顯著下降。各年齡層病例數分布因省份而異,其中,金夏沙省20歲以上的族群最為嚴重,南基伍/北基伍省逾50%病例數為10歲以下族群。UNICEF已於赤道/北基伍/南基伍省等6省展開第2次疫苗接種活動。
SUbzF8aWQXSkpTUfB8dfFg.en: The US reported its second and third clade I cases in January and February respectively. Case 2 was in Georgia and case 3 in New Hampshire, and both were confirmed after returning from affected areas; the two cases are not linked. Authorities have launched an epidemiological investigation and recommend vaccination for high-risk people. The risk to the general public is assessed as low, and low to moderate for people with high-risk sexual behaviour. Hong Kong reported one new case, a 37-year-old man with a chronic illness and high-risk exposure. He developed symptoms on 28 January, sought care on 4 February, and is in isolation; the source of infection is still under investigation. UNICEF reported that the Democratic Republic of the Congo recorded 64,173 suspected cases, 14,053 confirmed cases and 1,341 deaths in 2024 (CFR: 2.08%). Reported cases have trended downward since mid-October 2024, although confirmed numbers are still fluctuating, and weekly average reports fell below 2,500 in December. Age distribution varies by province: in Kinshasa, people aged over 20 are most affected, while in South Kivu and North Kivu more than 50% of cases are under 10. UNICEF has launched a second round of vaccination in six provinces, including Équateur, North Kivu and South Kivu.

5Twt2-fMrbQy8rHZtTxQVQ.zh: 剛果民主共和國西部赤道省博洛姆巴區自1/10-1/22期間報告12例疑病例,8例死亡,已採檢樣本檢驗中;該省前次疫情發生在2022 年4~7月期間。
5Twt2-fMrbQy8rHZtTxQVQ.en: In Bolomba Health Zone, Équateur Province in western DRC, 12 suspected cases and 8 deaths were reported between 10 and 22 January. Samples have been collected and are being tested. The province's previous outbreak occurred from April to July 2022.

zVz9cO2-Hgs2r52mNnJLkA.zh: 非洲疫情持續,第1週累計4國報告339例病例,其中61例確診,5例死亡(CFR:1.2%);分別是迦納累計報告297例病例,3例死亡;辛巴威累計24例(無人死亡);馬拉威累計14例病例(2例死亡);尚比亞累計4例病例(無人死亡)。 安哥拉疫情上升,2025年迄第2週累計3省報告224例,其中32例確診,18例死亡(CFR:8%),病患年齡涵蓋2-70歲,且女性占比54%,該國上次爆發疫情為2018年(累計1,262例病例,19例死亡,CFR:1.5%)。 非洲2024年全年報告累計20國,共235,387例病例,其中30,583確診,3,747例死亡(CFR:1.59%),累計病例數國家前五名依序為蘇丹(51,615例)、剛果民主共和國(30,373例)、衣索比亞(26,052例)、索馬利亞(21,739例)、尚比亞(20,076例)。
zVz9cO2-Hgs2r52mNnJLkA.en: The outbreak in Africa continues. In week 1, four countries cumulatively reported 339 cases, of which 61 were confirmed, and 5 deaths (CFR 1.2%): Ghana 297 cases and 3 deaths; Zimbabwe 24 cases (no deaths); Malawi 14 cases (2 deaths); and Zambia 4 cases (no deaths). Angola's outbreak is increasing: as of week 2 of 2025, three provinces had reported 224 cases cumulatively, including 32 confirmed and 18 deaths (CFR 8%). Patients are aged 2–70, and women account for 54%. The country's previous outbreak was in 2018 (1,262 cases and 19 deaths, CFR 1.5%). In 2024, Africa reported 235,387 cases in 20 countries cumulatively, including 30,583 confirmed and 3,747 deaths (CFR 1.59%). The five countries with the most cumulative cases were Sudan (51,615), the Democratic Republic of the Congo (30,373), Ethiopia (26,052), Somalia (21,739) and Zambia (20,076).

vJs3_0ExWQtiyOi_splGpg.zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於1/1-1/8期間,巴基斯坦報告新增1例WPV1型病例;共2國新增4例cVDPV2型病例,分別為奈及利亞3例、印1例。環境樣本部分,巴基斯坦新增13件WPV1型陽性樣本;英國新增1例cVDPV2型陽性樣本。 2024年全年病例數,其中奈及利亞累計93例cVDPV2型,巴基斯坦累計報告68例WPV1型,剛果民主共和國累計9例cVDPV1與14例cVDPV2型,印累計7例cVDPV2型,南蘇丹10例cVDPV2 型。
vJs3_0ExWQtiyOi_splGpg.en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that during 1–8 January, Pakistan reported one new WPV1 case. Two countries reported four new cVDPV2 cases: three in Nigeria and one in Indonesia. For environmental samples, Pakistan reported 13 new WPV1-positive samples, and the United Kingdom reported one new cVDPV2-positive sample. Full-year 2024 case counts: Nigeria cumulatively reported 93 cVDPV2 cases; Pakistan 68 WPV1 cases; the Democratic Republic of the Congo 9 cVDPV1 and 14 cVDPV2 cases; Indonesia 7 cVDPV2 cases; and South Sudan 10 cVDPV2 cases.

mXC_rdG5Sve-fv7PV2mdog.zh: 非洲報告自2024年初截至52週累計3國共294例病例,其中42例確診,8例死亡;分別是烏干達277例病例,6例死亡、剛果民主共和國10例病例(2例死亡)及肯亞7例病例(無人死亡),WHO評估傳播風險為中,當局呼籲加強監測與妥善處理動物遺體。
mXC_rdG5Sve-fv7PV2mdog.en: Africa reported 294 cases cumulatively from early 2024 to week 52 across three countries, including 42 confirmed and 8 deaths: Uganda 277 cases and 6 deaths, the Democratic Republic of the Congo 10 cases (2 deaths), and Kenya 7 cases (no deaths). WHO assesses the transmission risk as moderate. Authorities urge strengthened surveillance and proper handling of animal carcasses.

cySKfmVQceei8CFrRSvb3w.zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於去年12/19-12/31期間,巴基斯坦報告新增3例WPV1型病例;共2國新增3例cVDPV2,分別為剛果民主共和國2例、南蘇丹1例。環境樣本部分,巴基斯坦新增52件WPV1型陽性樣本;共3國新增6件cVDPV2型陽性樣本,分別為象牙海岸4件、阿爾及利亞/波蘭各1件。 2024年巴基斯坦累計報告WPV1型67例,剛果民主共和國累計WPV1型9例與cVDPV2型14例,南蘇丹cVDPV2 型10例。
cySKfmVQceei8CFrRSvb3w.en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that during 19–31 December last year, Pakistan reported three new WPV1 cases. Two countries reported three new cVDPV2 cases: two in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and one in South Sudan. For environmental samples, Pakistan reported 52 new WPV1-positive samples. Three countries reported six new cVDPV2-positive samples: four in Côte d'Ivoire, and one each in Algeria and Poland. For 2024, Pakistan cumulatively reported 67 WPV1 cases; the Democratic Republic of the Congo cumulatively reported 9 WPV1 cases and 14 cVDPV2 cases; and South Sudan reported 10 cVDPV2 cases.

7zv9z9LxPNt1DXcAvONRzA.zh: WHO 12/27更新剛果民主共和國寬果省Panzi區疫情,自10月下旬爆發不明原因疾病,截至12/16累計報告891例病例,其中48例死亡,多為5歲以下兒童。依現有實驗室檢驗結果顯示,檢出陽性樣本包含瘧疾及常見呼吸道病毒,顯示瘧疾及呼吸道病毒共同感染引發,另營養不良導致嚴重感染及死亡。WHO評估疫情於該國內、區域及全球傳播風險為低,惟該國營養不良情況日益嚴重,其類疫情可能發生於該國其他地區。
7zv9z9LxPNt1DXcAvONRzA.en: WHO, in an update on 27 December, reported an outbreak in Panzi Health Zone, Kwango Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo. An undiagnosed illness broke out in late October; as of 16 December, 891 cases had been reported cumulatively, including 48 deaths, mostly among children under five. Current laboratory results show that the positive samples included malaria and common respiratory viruses, indicating co-infection with malaria and respiratory viruses, with malnutrition leading to severe infection and death. WHO assesses the risk of spread within the country, regionally and globally as low. However, malnutrition in the country is becoming increasingly serious, and similar outbreaks may occur in other parts of the country.

vhueivytZYQdEHV9podSRQ.zh: 剛果民主共和國寬果省Panzi區疫情自10月爆發迄今累計報告592例病例,多為兒童,致死率約6.2%,當局12/20表示,病患檢體中,瘧疾於PCR及快篩之陽性率分別為86%及63%,另亦檢出流感、新冠、鼻病毒等呼吸道病毒陽性,其中流感陽性高達28%,顯示本次疫情病患可能係於營養不良狀況下,存在上述呼吸道病毒及瘧疾之合併感染。
vhueivytZYQdEHV9podSRQ.en: In the Panzi Health Zone of Kwango Province, DRC, an outbreak that began in October has cumulatively reported 592 cases, mostly children, with a case fatality rate of about 6.2%. On 20 December, authorities said that among patient samples, malaria was positive in 86% by PCR and 63% by rapid diagnostic test. Other respiratory viruses were also detected, including influenza, COVID-19 and rhinovirus, with influenza positivity as high as 28%. This indicates that patients in this outbreak may have had co-infection with these respiratory viruses and malaria in the context of malnutrition.

5zbcXF18D6vXj_gmNKqCjw.zh: 依ACDC統計,非洲今年截至12/16累計20國報告65,947例病例,其中14,394例確診,1,239例死亡(CFR:1.88%),以剛果民主共和國報告10,533例確診最為嚴峻,蒲隆地2,402例次之,烏干達925例疫情明顯上升,其餘各國報告1至118例不等。 ACDC 12/19表示,預計下週取得首批5萬劑LC16疫苗,2月起並將陸續到貨300萬劑,該疫苗可用於1歲以上兒童,可填補目前兒童疫苗接種無法涵蓋之族群。
5zbcXF18D6vXj_gmNKqCjw.en: According to Africa CDC statistics, as of 16 December this year, 20 countries in Africa had reported 65,947 cases cumulatively, including 14,394 confirmed and 1,239 deaths (CFR 1.88%). The Democratic Republic of the Congo, with 10,533 confirmed cases, is the most severely affected; Burundi, with 2,402 cases, ranks second, and Uganda, with 925 cases, shows a marked increase. The remaining countries reported between 1 and 118 cases each. Africa CDC stated on 19 December that it expects to receive the first 50,000 doses of LC16 vaccine the following week, with 3 million doses to arrive in batches from February. The vaccine can be used in children over one year old, filling a gap in populations not covered by current childhood vaccination.

j__tZ31OGry2ptCYuGZ9sA.zh: 剛果民主共和國寬果省Panzi區不明原因疫情更新,該國12/17公布實驗室檢驗結果,此波疫情為瘧疾,並因患者營養不良以致疫情更為嚴峻,目前累計報告592例病例,致死率約6.2%;WHO表示迄仍有檢體樣本檢測中,後續將有更完整的病因報告。
j__tZ31OGry2ptCYuGZ9sA.en: There is an update on the unexplained outbreak in Panzi Health Zone, Kwango Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo. On 17 December, the country released laboratory results showing that this wave is malaria, and that malnutrition in patients has made the outbreak more severe. A cumulative 592 cases have been reported, with a case fatality rate of about 6.2%. WHO says some specimens are still being tested, and a more complete report on the cause will follow.

Hqxm_LoYSKmQ37Zau5Hq4Q.zh: 依ACDC統計,非洲今年截至11/29累計20國報告62,789例病例,其中13,848例確診,1,204例死亡(CFR:1.85%),以剛果民主共和國報告10,158例確診最為嚴峻,蒲隆地2,392例次之,烏干達784例疫情明顯上升,其餘各國報告1至118例不等。 ACDC表示,上週新增病例數顯著增加,仍以剛果民主共和國為多,另自7月中旬以來,Ib型的檢出量持續穩定上升。
Hqxm_LoYSKmQ37Zau5Hq4Q.en: According to Africa CDC statistics, as of 29 November this year, 20 countries in Africa had reported 62,789 cases cumulatively, including 13,848 confirmed and 1,204 deaths (CFR 1.85%). The Democratic Republic of the Congo, with 10,158 confirmed cases, is the most severely affected, followed by Burundi with 2,392 cases; Uganda, with 784 cases, shows a marked increase. The remaining countries reported between 1 and 118 cases each. Africa CDC stated that case numbers rose significantly last week, still concentrated in the Democratic Republic of the Congo; since mid-July, detections of clade Ib have continued to rise steadily.

JPRyPCXBRyl_MmRXvxbLew.zh: WHO 12/11更新剛果民主共和國Panzi區疫情,表示目前於12件樣本中檢出10件瘧疾陽性,並推測引發本次疫情不止1種疾病,將收集更多樣本進行檢測,以確定病因;當地目前累計報告416例病例,其中31例死亡。
JPRyPCXBRyl_MmRXvxbLew.en: WHO updated on 11 December on the outbreak in the Panzi area of the Democratic Republic of the Congo, reporting that 10 of 12 samples tested positive for malaria. WHO suspects that more than one disease may be behind the outbreak, and more samples will be collected and tested to determine the cause. The area has reported a cumulative 416 cases, including 31 deaths.

eBifa3GfGN-apIt1EVzBvw.zh: 剛果民主共和國西南部寬果省11月中旬起爆發不明疾病,病患出現類流感疾病症狀,包括發燒、頭痛、咳嗽及貧血等,目前已報告143例死亡,以婦女及兒童受影響最劇,當局已派遣醫療團隊進駐採樣分析。
eBifa3GfGN-apIt1EVzBvw.en: An unidentified disease broke out from mid-November in Kwango Province in southwestern Democratic Republic of the Congo. Patients show influenza-like symptoms, including fever, headache, cough and anaemia. A total of 143 deaths have been reported so far, with women and children most severely affected. Authorities have sent medical teams to the site to collect and analyse samples.

_a2LG9aPvfpGyxIexkufmQ.zh: 越南胡志明市疫情持續上升,單週新增病例數突破200例,今年截至11/22累計報告逾1,800例,其中3例死亡,當局已加強疫苗接種措施。 吉爾吉斯今年截至9月累計報告13,358例病例,疫情於6月達高峰後持續下降,目前已趨緩,病例多分布於北部及西南部州別,當局已加強疫苗接種。 非洲疫情持續,今年截至11/8累計報告23萬2,363例病例,其中21,214例確診,3,136例死亡(CFR:1.35%),以剛果民主共和國報告9.2萬餘例最為嚴峻、另有衣索比亞、蒲隆地、摩洛哥、索馬利亞、奈及利亞及布吉納法索報告1至2.8萬餘例,查德及象牙海岸報告7千至8千餘例,21國報告數十至5千例不等。
_a2LG9aPvfpGyxIexkufmQ.en:
Viet Nam: In Ho Chi Minh City, the outbreak continues to rise, with weekly new cases exceeding 200. As of 22 November this year, more than 1,800 cases have been cumulatively reported, including 3 deaths, and authorities have stepped up vaccination measures.

Kyrgyzstan: As of September this year, 13,358 cases have been cumulatively reported. The outbreak peaked in June and has declined since, and is now slowing. Cases are mainly distributed in the northern and south-western regions, and authorities have stepped up vaccination.

Africa: The outbreak continues. As of 8 November this year, 232,363 cases have been cumulatively reported, including 21,214 confirmed cases and 3,136 deaths (CFR: 1.35%). The Democratic Republic of the Congo has been most severely affected, reporting more than 92,000 cases. Ethiopia, Burundi, Morocco, Somalia, Nigeria and Burkina Faso each reported between 1 and more than 28,000 cases; Chad and Côte d'Ivoire reported 7,000 to more than 8,000 cases; and 21 countries reported from several dozen to 5,000 cases.

Tz8N6ryupaUilUUT7EpaRw.zh: 依ACDC統計,非洲今年截至11/8累計20國報告55,413例病例,其中12,162例確診,1,142例死亡(CFR:2.06%),以剛果民主共和國報告9,456例確診最為嚴峻,蒲隆地1,834例次之,烏干達443例疫情明顯上升,其餘各國報告1至118例不等。 加拿大曼托巴省11/22報告該國首例Ib型病例,個案近期有非洲流行國家旅遊史,目前隔離中,並進行接觸者追蹤,評估對一般民眾的風險仍低。
Tz8N6ryupaUilUUT7EpaRw.en:
According to Africa CDC, across Africa as of 8 November this year, 20 countries have cumulatively reported 55,413 cases, including 12,162 confirmed cases and 1,142 deaths (CFR: 2.06%). The Democratic Republic of the Congo is the most severely affected, reporting 9,456 confirmed cases, followed by Burundi with 1,834 cases. Uganda, with 443 cases, has seen a marked rise in its outbreak, and the remaining countries reported between 1 and 118 cases each.

Manitoba Province, Canada, reported the country's first clade Ib case on 22 November. The patient had recently travelled to an African country with ongoing outbreaks, is in isolation, and contacts are being traced. Authorities assess the risk to the general public as still low.

8CygmkAcw-4zLDIan3Gvsw.zh: 美國加州11/16報告首例第I型病例,病患具非洲旅遊史,目前於家中隔離,當局已追蹤相關接觸者,迄無持續傳播跡象。 非洲Ib型疫情持續,其中剛果民主共和國、蒲隆地原多係透過年輕人性接觸傳播,惟隨感染族群擴大,已轉為家庭及社區傳播,幼兒感染比例亦上升;烏干達近期疫情明顯上升,多係透過性接觸感染。 ACDC 11/6已與生技公司合作,啟動天花藥物 brincidofovir (TEMBEXA)用於治療M痘之相關試驗。
8CygmkAcw-4zLDIan3Gvsw.en:
California, United States, reported its first clade I case on 16 November. The patient had travel history to Africa and is isolated at home. Authorities have traced related contacts, and there are no signs of ongoing transmission so far.

Clade Ib outbreaks continue in Africa. In the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Burundi, transmission was originally mostly through sexual contact among young people; as the affected population has expanded, transmission has shifted to household and community spread, and the proportion of young children infected has also risen. In Uganda, the outbreak has risen markedly recently, with infection mostly through sexual contact.

Africa CDC, on 6 November, worked with a biotechnology company to launch trials of the smallpox drug brincidofovir (TEMBEXA) for treating Mpox.

bnprSACli8E3REcICwrMaw.en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that between 31 October and 6 November, Pakistan added 1 WPV1 case; the Democratic Republic of the Congo added 2 cVDPV1 cases; and a total of 5 countries added 12 cVDPV2 cases: Nigeria 7, Yemen 2, and Ethiopia, Senegal and Niger 1 each. ucnRYGmiiNt-88y0i1mb0Q.en: According to Africa CDC, in Africa as of 25 October this year, 19 countries have cumulatively reported 49,310 cases, including 10,672 confirmed cases and 1,059 deaths (CFR: 2.15%). The Democratic Republic of the Congo is the most severely affected, with 8,607 confirmed cases, followed by Burundi with 1,059 cases. The remaining countries reported between 1 and 175 cases each.

YwWx3qmKFFHfXZLXHGq3Qg.en: Africa has cumulatively reported 45,672 cases in 18 countries so far this year as of 18 October, including 9,298 confirmed cases and 1,014 deaths. The Democratic Republic of the Congo is the most severely affected, with 7,517 confirmed cases (1,005 deaths), followed by Burundi with 1,287 cases. The remaining countries reported between 1 and 152 cases each. In the region, the testing rate was about 52.8% and the positivity rate was 36.2%.

6yb7Wzzl2EwPuY2qMU6atQ.en: The Democratic Republic of the Congo formally launched a vaccination campaign on 5 October. Health workers and contacts are currently prioritized. Vaccination is planned to begin in North Kivu and South Kivu provinces and cover 11 of the most severely affected health zones across 6 provinces.

Mi7mhyVVSmRwhe_K3pD3jQ.en: The outbreak in Africa continues. As of 26 September this year, 218,258 cases have been reported cumulatively, of which 19,454 were confirmed and 2,968 died (CFR: 1.25%). The Democratic Republic of the Congo (over 85,000) and Ethiopia (over 27,000) account for the most cases. Burundi, Morocco, Nigeria, Burkina Faso and Somalia each reported over 10,000 cases, Chad and Côte d'Ivoire reported 7,000 to 8,000 cases, and 19 countries reported between several dozen and 5,000 cases. In southern Viet Nam, cases in Ho Chi Minh City have risen. Nearly 100 new cases were reported in the last week of September, and since the outbreak began (date unspecified), 743 cases have been reported cumulatively as of 26 September, mostly children under 5. Authorities say immunization coverage differs widely across districts in the city and currently exceeds 72%. Media reports also indicate that cases are rising in central and northern provinces of the country.
